speaker: NARRATOR
text:
――In the swaying dragon carriage, Rem was only thinking of him.

Suddenly hearing someone calling her name, Rem softly lifted her face and narrowed her eyes against the bright radiance of the sun.

She gazed at the entourage of dragon carriages ahead. Inside them, were the wounded soldiers of the battle with the White Whale.

All in all, only their most urgent wounds had been treated and more than a few of them were still seriously injured. Yet, despite their pain, the corners of their lips revealed only the sense of accomplishment for having fulfilled a long-cherished dream. After carrying this dream for so many years, to see it finally realized meant more to them than injury or death. Having achieved what they set out to do, they now ride towards the Royal Capital on their triumphant return.

Taking all this into her sight, Rem hated herself for not being able to hold back the pain inside her heart.

speaker: CRUSCH
text: You look anxious, Rem. Are you still worrying about him?

speaker: REM

text:

The fact that they rode in a carriage was also because Crusch didn’t feel comfortable letting Rem ride a ground dragon alone in this condition. So she resolved to accompany her, at least until the Royal Capital is within their sights.

Sensing Rem’s unsettled look, Crusch casually shrugged.

speaker: CRUSCH
text: Compared to this…
instruct: Neutral, descriptive narration with a calm and steady tone.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: She shook her head,
instruct: Confident and reassuring, with a composed and logical tone.

speaker: CRUSCH
text: He has Wilhelm, Ferris, the elites of the expedition, and Ricardo’s mercenary company, all there to assist him. Besides, Anastasia must have predicted this turn of events. Even if the adversary’s strength is a concern, I don’t think there is any reason they would lose.

speaker: REM
text: Even so, I still can’t help but selfishly worry.

speaker: CRUSCH

instruct: Neutral, descriptive narration with a warm and reflective tone.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Seeing Rem sink deeper into her worries, Crusch realized she had misspoken and lowered her eyes. But seeing the always cold and formal Crusch suddenly so out of character, Rem couldn’t help but curl the corners of her lips into a smile.

speaker: CRUSCH
text: Mn, that’s good.
instruct: Neutral, descriptive narration with a reflective and thoughtful tone.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Seeing this, Crusch nodded contently,
instruct: Calm and reflective, with a slightly nostalgic and sincere tone.

speaker: CRUSCH

speaker: REM

speaker: CRUSCH
text: People do say that. I can’t say I’m not angry about it. I guess just because I don’t smile for no reason in front of people, I’m becoming rather unlovable…
instruct: Crusch responds with a mix of frustration and vulnerability, hinting at her internal conflict over her stern demeanor.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Rem wasn’t sure whether to take that as a joke, but seeing Crusch’s gentle smile, her lips opened into a smile as well. Courageous and proud, to Rem, who had always been lacking confidence, Crusch was an ideal woman. But of course, in Rem’s heart, the highest honor was reserved for none other than her older sister, Ram.
instruct: Narrator delivers a calm, descriptive passage, highlighting Rem's admiration for Crusch and her devotion to Ram.

speaker: CRUSCH
text: Ahead of their path is the Witch Cult… Even though it was more or less to be expected considering Emilia’s identity, until we know more about them, caution is necessary. Natsuki Subaru realizes this, but surely Lord Mathers has a plan as well?
instruct: Crusch speaks with a commanding, strategic tone, addressing the looming threat of the Witch Cult.

speaker: REM
text: The depths of my master’s mind, Rem couldn’t possibly know. Even if you ask me, I wouldn’t be able to say.
instruct: Rem replies with a quiet, respectful tone, emphasizing her lack of insight into Subaru's thoughts.

speaker: CRUSCH
text: That’s harsh. Now that we’re allies after all, a little information slipping around wouldn’t be too bad.
instruct: Crusch speaks with a teasing, slightly playful tone, suggesting a shift in their dynamic as allies.

speaker: NARRATOR
text:
Perhaps it was meant to distract Rem from sinking into negative thoughts again. Indeed, it was thanks to Crusch that Rem wasn’t left alone with her worries.

Besides, Crusch made a good point. A man such as Roswaal L. Mathers must have had a grand plan for all this. Surely Subaru’s actions were all furthering his master’s goals, while also at the same time recovering his lost reputation.

Or, actually, with the slaying of the White Whale, his reputation had already far surpassed what it was before.

――Hero, Natsuki Subaru.

To Rem, whose heart and future he had saved, this assessment is only a matter of course, and considering the bright future he has yet to create, it is also more than justified.

And then, to be at the side of that radiant hero, a place he could occasionally turn to and make sure that she was there if only that place could hold her existence, then there is nothing else in the world Rem would wish for. With this alone, she would be content.

When Subaru appears in her mind, Rem’s heart is always full of turmoil. It becomes warm, and perhaps calm. Yet somehow it also becomes full of pain, of anxiety, of longing and worry. To give her heart at once so much happiness and so much suffering, only Subaru could do this to her.

With a smile carved upon her lips, Rem’s thoughts turned to her future her and Subaru’s future.

Stealing a glance at the side of Rem’s face, Crusch exhaled a sigh of relief. Caressing the scabbard of her Knight’s sword with her fingers, her eyes stared in silence into the road ahead ― Her thoughts were of the long path to the Royal Capital.
instruct: Narrator delivers a reflective, emotional passage, capturing Rem's complex feelings for Subaru and Crusch's silent resolve.

speaker: CRUSCH

speaker: NARRATOR
instruct: Neutral, even narration.

speaker: NARRATOR
text:
Crusch squinted her eyes, the same instant Rem heard a noise and raised her head.

What Crusch’s eyes captured was something off about the dragon carriage up ahead. The noise Rem heard came from the same direction. In fact, both clues were leading to the same conclusion.

In Crusch’s eyes, the dragon carriage disintegrated. In Rem’s ears, the prelude to collapse echoed like the sound of raindrops.

A mist of blood sprayed out. The image of the dragon carriage in front of them suddenly transformed into a pitiful blur.
instruct: Narrator delivers a dramatic, vivid description of the sudden attack and its aftermath.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: The ground dragon, the carriage, and all the wounded inside were completely uprooted, and then shattered mercilessly by overwhelming devastation.

speaker: CRUSCH
text: ――! Enemy attack!

speaker: NARRATOR
text:
Her astonished throat delayed only an instant, before Crusch bellowed out the rally call. With Crusch at the helm, the surrounding dragon carriages sensed the crisis and prepared for battle.

Rem, pushing away all sensations of injury and exhaustion and with her morning star in hand, stood up at once―― On the other side of the blood mist was the upright shadow of a man.

Who is that man, now burning into her sight, standing in the middle of the road?

Without weapon, without armor, without fear. Without compassion or malice or intent――!
instruct: Narrator delivers a tense, fast-paced passage, building suspense as the dragon carriage charges forward.

speaker: CRUSCH
text: ――Run him over!!

speaker: NARRATOR
text:
Crusch’s command came roaring from atop the driver’s platform. Hearing the command, the Knight-driver snapped the reins in acknowledgment. With a cry, the ground dragon led the carriage charging―― with surging momentum capable of shredding any victim coming into contact.

Without deviation from the mark, it was a head-on collision into the upright figure. The man showed no intention of moving. And just like that, the two objects touched, the slender body about to be ripped to shreds by the―.
instruct: Narrator continues with a dramatic, fast-paced description of the impending collision and Rem's reaction.

speaker: REM
text: Crusch-sama――!
instruct: Rem cries out in alarm, showing her concern for Crusch and her quick action to save her.

speaker: NARRATOR
text:
With this cry, Rem picked up Crusch by the waist and flew off the side of the carriage. There was no time to reach for the driver, Rem landed biting her lip, thinking this.

And then, right after――.
instruct: Narrator delivers a tense, descriptive passage, highlighting the surreal and horrifying scene.

speaker: MAN
text: Agh, really? Don’t do that. I didn’t even do anything, and someone wants to crush me to death. Really, that isn’t what people should be doing. I don’t think so.
instruct: The man speaks with a casual, almost dismissive tone, showing no fear despite the danger.

speaker: NARRATOR
text:
He spoke with the relaxed demeanor of a man leisurely walking in a park or basking in the sun or some such situation.

If it weren’t for the shattered debris of what used to be the dragon carriage, Rem would not have found this scene to be so bizarrely horrifying.

No matter how you look at it, the man doesn’t seem anything out of the ordinary.

His body was slender, and his neat white hair was neither long nor short, nor particularly odd. His black clothes were neither flamboyant nor shabby, and his face was not eye-catching at all. He looked so very ordinary that perhaps no matter where you put him, he would not seem out of place, and if you met him on the street, you’d forget him within ten seconds.

But the fact is, upon encountering this man, the ground dragon was ripped in two, its feet still in mid-stride, and then, along with the driver and carriage, shattered into countless indiscernible pieces.

The most frightening part is, though Rem never looked away, all she saw was this man merely standing there.

Not doing anything, just by standing there the man survived collision with a charging dragon carriage, and still stood there as if it were nothing.
instruct: Narrator delivers a detailed, eerie description of the man's appearance and the destruction he caused.

speaker: CRUSCH
text: Thank you, Rem, for saving me. But… it seems the situation hasn’t improved.
instruct: Crusch speaks with a mix of gratitude and determination, acknowledging Rem's help and the ongoing threat.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Still being carried in Rem’s arms, Crusch thanked her, stood back up, and in the same instant drew her Knight’s sword from its sheath. For the driver who followed her order and was shattered into a thousand pieces as a result, Crusch grieved his death in her heart and narrowed her eyes,
instruct: Narrator describes Crusch's emotional and physical reaction, showing her grief and resolve.

speaker: CRUSCH
text: To so cruelly murder my subjects, do not think this will end so easily… Who are you?

speaker: NARRATOR
text: With her naked blade gleaming with the intent to kill, she threw these words at the man. Taking in these words, the man touched his chin and began nodding as if he understood.

speaker: CRUSCH
text: Idle talk ends now―― Answer my question, or the next time I shall slay you.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Not paying any attention to Crusch’s demand, the man just kept on and on. And then,

.

instruct: Narrate with a tone of awe and disbelief, describing the impact of the technique.

His existence was utterly unaffected by a slash that could rend even the White Whale’s armor. The man’s body―― No, even his clothes were unscathed.

He did not defend the attack. Rather, it was something wholly different and unknown.

Crusch could not help but hold her breath, and Rem froze in place, after witnessing something so far outside the realm of understanding. In front of them, the man sighed for the first time.

So, it’s like that, is it? Well you’re free to do that. Alright, let’s just say it’s like that. But then, what is that supposed to mean?

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Seeing the two standing silently in front of him bracing for an attack, he tilted his head and stared at them with his sharp eyes, and then, with a smothered voice,
instruct: Speak with a tone of quiet, simmering rage, emphasizing the violation of rights.

speaker: NARRATOR
text:
Just as a chill ran up Rem’s back, the man took a step forward. His drooping arm lifted, sweeping up a small gust of wind.

Then, on the same line as the motion of his arm―― The earth, the air, and the world parted in two.

Round and round and round, Crusch’s severed left shoulder flew into the air.

Still grasping onto the sheath of a Knight’s sword, the arm dropped down in a spray of blood. Crusch, blown off her feet by the impact, fell to the ground, convulsing in pain and mass loss of blood.

speaker: REM
text: Crusch-sama――
instruct: Speak with a tone of shock and concern, expressing Rem's alarm at Crusch's condition.

speaker: NARRATOR
text:
.

Stunned for few seconds, Rem rushed to the side of the fallen Crusch. She placed her hands on Crusch’s wound and with the small final remnant of her Mana, applied all her power to stop the bleeding.

Crusch’s shoulder flowed bright crimson, the flesh, bones, nerves and arteries were all perfectly severed. A clean and masterful attack, Rem sighed with a rather inappropriate admiration.
instruct: Narrate with a tone of admiration and awe, describing the precision of the attack.

speaker: CRUSCH
text: Ferris… Oh… You?
instruct: Speak with a tone of confusion and recognition, expressing Crusch's dazed realization.

speaker: NARRATOR
text:
Under Rem’s healing hands, Crusch looked on with unfocused eyes, muttering indiscernibly, and, with her remaining right arm, grasped tightly onto Rem’s knee. Proof that she still possessed the strength to live. Crusch clenched her teeth, enduring her pain.

Rem kept her eyes on the man’s every movement.

She has no means of defending against his strikes. At the first sign of an attack, to leap away with Crusch is the only thing she could do.
instruct: Narrate with a tone of eerie realization and growing dread, highlighting the isolation of the scene.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: In a moment of eerie realization ― for some reason Crusch and Rem are all alone ― why hasn’t anyone come to their aid? In this critical juncture, with their lord gravely wounded, those Knights who did not cower even in the face of the White Whale, why―.
instruct: Speak with a tone of shrill, chaotic energy, expressing the youth's gluttonous enthusiasm.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Ahh, seriously… No matter how much we eat, it's not enough! This is why we can never stop living. Eating, feeding, chewing, biting, eating down, eating up, chewing up, chewing down, licking, lapping, sucking, inhaling, devouring, gluttonous drinking! Gluttony! Ahh—— Thanks for the meal tsu!
instruct: Narrate with a tone of chilling horror and disbelief, describing the youth's appearance and the aftermath of the battle.

speaker: NARRATOR
text:
All of a sudden from behind came the shrill, ear-splitting voice of a teenager.

Like the first man, the youth’s voice sent chills running up Rem’s spine. Her body stiff, she turned to look at him. The youth stood among several empty carriages, from head to toe he was covered in blood.

His long, dark-brown hair extending all the way down to his knees, his body was short, about the same height as Rem, and perhaps two or three years younger ― perhaps not much older than the kids in the village near the mansion.

Under his hair, only a thin, blood-soaked rag covers his slender body. Every inch of his skin is coated with blood.

Of course, none of the blood was his. It was from the Knights lying at his feet.

While Crusch and Rem were in a standoff with the man in front, the Knights had engaged the enemy behind them. In the end, before Rem even sensed any combat, it was already over.

speaker: REM
text: You people, are…
instruct: Deliver with trembling, hesitant tone, showing fear and shock.

speaker: NARRATOR
text:
Her voice quivering, Rem, with Crusch in her arms, backed up until both enemies were within her field of vision. Blood from Crusch’s shoulder had dyed the road red. Now the air turned cold, as if mocking their weakness, their fear.

Hearing the question, the man and the youth looked at each other. As if it had all been arranged, they nodded to each other. Then with the same deranged smile of violent delight, they announced their name.
instruct: Narrate with a cold, detached tone, describing the scene and characters' actions.

speaker: YOUTH

speaker: NARRATOR
instruct: Neutral, even narration.

Which's exactly why, which's exactly why, eating them is filling!⁶
instruct: Deliver with a wild, enthusiastic tone, repeating phrases with increasing intensity and a slightly slurred speech.

speaker: NARRATOR
text:
.

Witch Cult―― and Sin Archbishops, to boot.

When those words reached Rem’s ears, she stood frozen in place.

With an exhilarated expression the youth stomped on the ground while howling in strange noises. Spinning, as if dancing, his arms pointed to the fallen Knights, and then looked at them as if with overwhelming compassion.

speaker: NARRATOR
text:
Batenkaitos of Gluttony descended into a fit of deranged laughter, and Regulus of Greed shrugged disinterestedly.

Two Sin Archbishops appearing in the same place at the same time, Rem sank into thought.

In terms of strength, defeating these two is impossible.

Even though Crusch’s bleeding had been stopped, she is still in critical condition. Whether the Knights are dead or comatose, they can no longer fight.

To heal Crusch, Rem had already overspent her mana, though if she were to transform into demon mode, she will be able to absorb mana from the atmosphere and put up a fight. But against these two, victory is inconceivable.

On the one hand is the flawless offense and defense of Greed. Known to be able to capture a city single-handedly, it is impossible to measure the full extent of his power. On the other hand, Gluttony is no less formidable. Though his abilities are as-of-yet unknown, he has managed to wipe out an entire battle tested army within seconds. No matter what, Rem could not see victory waiting for her in the near future.

She quickly scanned the battlefield the Liger carriages are nowhere to be seen. The demi-human mercenaries were tasked with transporting wounded soldiers ― and the head of the White Whale. They might have escaped in the chaos and be retreating full speed toward the Royal Capital right now. Commanding them must be the Fang of Iron Vice Captain ― Hetaro ― bright and resourceful, and possessing great common sense and judgement…

If given enough time, perhaps he will return with reinforcements.

But, even so ― it will probably not arrive in time for Rem.

The moment before Subaru’s strength injected into his legs, the words of reproach rang out in the room.

In her dark blue evening dress, up to now frail and timid, she transformed all of a sudden ― majestic and fierce, her gaze was that of a Knight.
instruct: Narrate with dramatic emphasis on Crusch’s transformation, tone shifting from calm to powerful.

speaker: CRUSCH
text: As Natsuki Subaru-sama said, to ask what you do not know, is nothing deserving of mockery. Even you do not have that right. Understood?
instruct: Speak with cold superiority, voice laced with mockery and condescension.

speaker: FERRIS
text: …Understood, Crusch-sama.
instruct: Respond with hesitant, apologetic tone, voice trembling slightly.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Her forceful words subsiding, Crusch seemed to return to the soft-spoken girl of a moment before. But as if having heard something from the awe-inspiring Crusch of the past, from this now frail and feminine girl, Subaru could not hold in his astonishment. Ferris too, could not contain the shock within his eyes.
instruct: Narrate with a tone of awe and disbelief, highlighting the contrast in Crusch’s demeanor.

speaker: FERRIS
text: Emilia-sama, please accept my apology for my rudeness. Subaru-kyun too.
instruct: Speak with sincere apology, voice soft and apologetic.

speaker: SUBARU
text: You… N―no, it’s fine. Then, let’s talk about the Witch Cult now. Emilia-tan wants to hear it. And to be honest, I don’t know the details either…
instruct: Deliver with hesitant, uncertain tone, voice showing reluctance.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Seeing Subaru back down, half giving up, Ferris lightheartedly replied with an
instruct: Narrate with a light, teasing tone, hinting at Ferris’s playful nature.

text: Understood-nyan
speaker: FERRIS
instruct: Speak with playful, childish tone, ending with a soft 'nyan'.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: . A finger lightly touching the lower lip, Ferris shook around in the short dress.
instruct: Narrate with a casual, observational tone, describing Ferris’s actions.

speaker: FERRIS
text: Firstly, as Emilia-sama said, the Witch Cult is an organization that worships the Witch of Envy. Ever since the unstoppable rise of the Witch four-hundred years ago, these fanatics have been active. To the Knights’ order, all affiliates of this organization are to be killed-on-sight.
instruct: Speak with shocked, questioning tone, voice showing disbelief.

speaker: EMILIA
text: Killed-on-sight… How could you carry out such extreme orders?
instruct: Narrate with grim, factual tone, emphasizing the horror of the Witch Cult.

speaker: FERRIS
text: The Witch Cultists will not hesitate to burn a village or an entire city just to accomplish their goals. In fact, the village near Lord Roswaal’s mansion came close to falling victim to these Cultists, and one of the Sin Archbishops that took part in the ambush had once managed to single handedly capture a city in the Vollachian Empire in the south.
instruct: Narrate with a tone of deep horror and unease, highlighting the scale of the threat.

speaker: NARRATOR
text:
Emilia kept on blinking her eyes, as if unable to take in these facts. Subaru understands her reaction, because the horrors of the Witch Cult had already been carved deep into his heart.

He now uses Petelgeuse as the standard unit of measurement for insanity.

But in terms of strength, Greed sounds like something on a completely different level than Petelgeuse.
instruct: Narrate with a calm, informative tone, shifting focus to the Sin Archbishops.

speaker: FERRIS
text: Wait, wait, I’m getting sidetracked-nyan… The Witch Cult Sin Archbishops, each named after one of the six Sins, other than Envy, are the executives of the organization.
instruct: Speak with a confident, slightly teasing tone, ending with a playful 'nyan'.

speaker: EMILIA
text: The six witches… were Sloth, Greed, Gluttony, Lust, Wrath and Pride, right?
instruct: Speak with a calm, knowledgeable tone, listing the six witches with clarity.

speaker: FERRIS
text: Yes, and especially well known among them are Sloth and Greed. Greed, as previously mentioned, is known for annihilating entire cities. Sloth, on the other hand, seemed to be behind every little disturbance caused by the Witch Cult. But Sloth has already been beautifully eliminated by our punitive expedition-nyan… Right, Subaru-kyun?
instruct: Speak with a confident, assured tone, emphasizing the elimination of Sloth.

speaker: SUBARU
text: Yes… Sloth is dead. I saw him disintegrate with my own eyes, there is no mistaking it.
instruct: Deliver with a shaken, haunted tone, voice trembling with memory.

speaker: NARRATOR
text:
Subaru confirmed Ferris’ words, his mind playing back the final moments of the abominable Petelgeuse. Screaming Subaru’s name, full of hatred… Even long afterward, the sound would not leave his ears. Like a curse, it kept on howling…

―Was that the reason behind Subaru’s cruel fate?
instruct: Narrate with a grim, ominous tone, emphasizing the threat of the Witch of Envy.

speaker: FERRIS
text: There are now five remaining Sin Archbishops. Two of them were responsible for the ambush on Crusch-sama. Their movements are always mysterious, and so even after four-hundred years the efforts to eradicate them barely made any progress. As to their objective… It is said that they want to revive the Witch of Envy-nyan.
instruct: Speak with a stunned, questioning tone, voice showing disbelief.

speaker: SUBARU
text: Revive… the Witch?
instruct: Deliver with sudden, frantic energy, voice showing shock and confusion.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Unable to disregard these words, Subaru jumped up, tipping over his chair. Noticing this gave the girls a fright, Subaru waved his hands up and down.
instruct: Narrate with a tone of confusion and disbelief, describing Subaru’s reaction.

speaker: SUBARU
text: To revive her… Is that even possible? The Witch has been dead for four-hundred years, right? To make something like that come back to life…
instruct: Deliver with a calm, solemn tone, voice carrying the weight of the revelation.

speaker: WILHELM
text: Subaru-dono, the Witch of Envy is not dead. Her life is still preserved at the edge of this world. Unfortunately.
instruct: Narrate with a tone of quiet intensity, highlighting the gravity of the situation.

speaker: NARRATOR
text:
To the agitated Subaru, Wilhelm quietly revealed this fact.

Speechless, Subaru looked to Wilhelm, and met his eyes, serious and severe.
instruct: Narrate with a serious, ominous tone, emphasizing the power of the Sealing Stone Shrine.

speaker: WILHELM
text: Near the Great Waterfall, the Sealing Stone Shrine is located. The Witch is there, her indestructible existence sealed inside. For even with the power of the Dragon and the Sword Saint combined, she cannot be destroyed.
instruct: Deliver with a calm, authoritative tone, emphasizing the gravity of the Witch's sealed existence.

speaker: SUBARU
text: Sealed… I might have heard that before… but to revive her, why don’t they just destroy the seal?
instruct: Speak with confusion and curiosity, questioning the logic of the Witch's seal.

speaker: NARRATOR
text:
Where did Subaru hear that before? But more importantly is the question…

…If the witch was sealed, they merely need to break the seal, but instead, every time a half-elf appears, they wreak havoc in the world with senseless murder and destruction. Just what is the Witch Cult trying to do? But at this question, Wilhelm shook his head.
instruct: Narrate with a neutral, reflective tone, highlighting the mystery and implications of the Witch Cult's actions.

speaker: WILHELM
text: To approach the temple is almost impossible. First, there is very little mana near the Great Fall, under those circumstances, no one can withstand the Witch’s Miasma. Secondly, they cannot bypass the Sage.
instruct: Deliver with a calm, authoritative tone, explaining the challenges of approaching the temple.

speaker: SUBARU
text: Sage…?
instruct: Speak with confusion and curiosity, questioning the identity of the Sage.

speaker: WILHELM
text: The Sage Shaula. Along with the first-generation Sword Saint, and the Divine Dragon Volcanica, these were the heroes who sealed the Witch. Then he/she⁷ retired to the Pleiades Watchtower near the Great Waterfall. But retired in name only, even now, for he/she is constantly watching, for those who would revive the Witch. ―That is, as the story goes.
instruct: Deliver with a calm, authoritative tone, explaining the Sage's role in sealing the Witch.

speaker: SUBARU
text: They must be… quite old…
instruct: Speak with a mix of awe and disbelief, commenting on the Sage's age.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Four hundred years is quite a long breath, even for Sages. But that is beside the point. Subaru decided to set that aside so Ferris could continue.
instruct: Narrate with a neutral, reflective tone, emphasizing the passage of time and Subaru's decision.

speaker: SUBARU
text: Well now we know why the Witch can’t be unsealed, but then how do they revive her?
instruct: Speak with confusion and curiosity, questioning how the Witch can be revived.

speaker: FERRIS
text: Even if you ask-nyan, Ferris isn’t a Witch Cultist and doesn’t know either. All we can do is torture a Witch Cultist and have them spit it out-nyan.
instruct: Deliver with a playful, dismissive tone, suggesting a solution through torture.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Brushing off Subaru’s question, Ferris took on an
instruct: Narrate with a neutral, observational tone, describing Ferris's expression.

text: I give up
speaker: FERRIS
instruct: Deliver with a playful, dismissive tone, expressing frustration and giving up.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: expression. Even though Subaru wasn’t satisfied, there was no point pursuing the question further. In any case, Emilia nodded.
instruct: Narrate with a neutral, reflective tone, describing the atmosphere and Emilia's reaction.

speaker: EMILIA
text: So that’s… why I’m treated like this… But why didn’t Puck…
instruct: Speak with emotional distress and confusion, questioning Puck's absence.

speaker: SUBARU
text: Did Puck say something just now? There is a mountain of things I need to ask him!
instruct: Speak with urgency and determination, expressing the need to speak with Puck.

speaker: EMILIA
text: Puck didn’t respond… Even though he seems to have materialized… I only know he’s nearby…
instruct: Speak with concern and confusion, expressing uncertainty about Puck's presence.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Seeing Emilia shriveling in her seat, it did not even occur to Subaru to say
instruct: Narrate with a neutral, observational tone, describing Subaru's inaction.

text: there, there
speaker: SUBARU
instruct: Deliver with a calm, resolute tone, emphasizing the importance of speaking with Puck.

speaker: NARRATOR
text:
. In fact, to talk to Puck is something he absolutely must do.

Besides, there is no way to predict where or when the Sin Archbishop of Greed will appear. Puck’s input will also be crucial.
instruct: Deliver with a playful, dismissive tone, shifting the focus to the future.

speaker: FERRIS
text: That’s all there is to say about the Witch Cult-nyan. So, on top of that, let’s move the discussion to the future.
instruct: Speak with confusion and curiosity, questioning the future.

speaker: SUBARU
text: The future…?
instruct: Narrate with a neutral, observational tone, describing Ferris's jubilant demeanor.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Turning to Subaru with a clap, Ferris, with a jubilant smile, said.
instruct: Deliver with a playful, dismissive tone, suggesting dissolving the Alliance.

speaker: FERRIS
text: To put it simply, this Alliance… let’s dissolve it-nyan.
instruct: Narrate with a dramatic, tense tone, highlighting the frozen atmosphere and Subaru's reaction.

speaker: NARRATOR
text:
※　※　※　※　※　※　※　※　※　※　※　※　※

The atmosphere in the lounge froze. Only Subaru’s mind was heating up.

Taking in those words, he pondered a moment, quietly licking his lips.
instruct: Speak with confusion and urgency, questioning Ferris's suggestion.

speaker: SUBARU
text: Dissolve the Alliance? What are you trying to say?
instruct: Deliver with a playful, dismissive tone, explaining the reasoning behind dissolving the Alliance.

speaker: FERRIS
text: Exactly what it sounds like-nyan. As things are right now, our Alliance will not be mutually beneficial-nyan.
instruct: Delivered with a calm, mocking tone, emphasizing the '-nyan' suffix with a playful lilt.

speaker: NARRATOR
text:
Perhaps because Subaru kept his composure, Ferris’ expression revealed a touch of admiration.

Rather annoyed by Ferris’ expression, Subaru wondered if Ferris was setting up the Alliance as a bargaining chip to gain an advantage in the negotiation. The more he thought, the more he commanded himself to keep calm. But even so, his head was nearly boiling.
instruct: Neutral, even narration with a slight pause between the two paragraphs for dramatic effect.

speaker: SUBARU
text: Mining rights aside, we coordinated our efforts to defeat the White Whale, and after everything is done, now you want to back out after reaping the benefits? That’s a bit scandalous no matter how you look at it.
instruct: Angry and accusatory, with a sharp tone and emphasis on 'scandalous'.

speaker: FERRIS
text: More detriment than benefits, Subaru-kyun.
instruct: Calm and dismissive, with a soft '-kyun' suffix and a hint of condescension.

speaker: SUBARU
text: Ah?
instruct: Short and surprised, with a questioning inflection.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Compared to Subaru’s aggressive attitude, Ferris went on casually, wagging a finger.
instruct: Neutral, even narration with a casual tone, describing Ferris' actions.

speaker: FERRIS
text: Nyan? Gluttony and Greed appearing together, for starters. After killing Sloth, an Alliance with Emilia-sama’s camp will only make us targeted by the Witch Cult… Considering what happened to Crusch-sama… Do you still believe it’s in our interest to form an Alliance right now?
instruct: Calm but pointed, with a logical and analytical tone, emphasizing the risks mentioned.

speaker: SUBARU
text: That is…
instruct: Hesitant and conflicted, with a tone of internal struggle and uncertainty.

speaker: NARRATOR
text:
Glancing toward the completely different Crusch, Subaru hesitated to counter Ferris’ argument. Because deep in his heart, he was carrying the same wounds.

This time, it wasn’t Subaru who refuted Ferris’ words.
instruct: Neutral, even narration with a reflective tone, highlighting Subaru's internal conflict.

speaker: WILHELM
text: I disagree, Ferris.
instruct: Authoritative and firm, with a commanding tone and direct address to Ferris.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Leaning forward in his seat, Wilhelm’s stern gaze stared into Ferris’ eyes. Ferris, eyelids narrowed, let out an
instruct: Neutral, even narration with a tense and confrontational tone, describing Wilhelm's actions.

text: Eh-?
speaker: FERRIS
instruct: Surprised and confused, with a short, hesitant utterance.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: with a thin smile.
instruct: Neutral, even narration with a subtle, smirking tone, describing Ferris' expression.

speaker: FERRIS
text: What do you mean-nyan? After what Gluttony did to Crusch-sama, what do you think is the benefit of an Alliance that will draw the Witch Cult to us?
instruct: Accusatory and emotional, with a sharp tone and emphasis on 'Crusch-sama'.

speaker: WILHELM
text: To kill Gluttony… An opportunity to avenge our master.
instruct: Firm and resolute, with a tone of determination and a focus on vengeance.

speaker: FERRIS
text: Vengeance? Is that more important to you than Crusch-sama’s life!?
instruct: Angry and emphatic, with a tone of frustration and concern for Crusch-sama.

speaker: NARRATOR
text:
Against Wilhelm, Ferris refused to give ground.

Weighing heavily on both their minds, were thoughts of their master.
instruct: Neutral, even narration with a somber tone, highlighting the weight of their thoughts.

speaker: FERRIS
text: If we continue to deal with the Witch Cult this disaster will only repeat again! Crusch-sama right now can’t even protect herself! When that day comes… If it’s physical wound or emotional wound, Ferris can heal you… But if you die it’s all over isn’t it!?
instruct: Urgent and desperate, with a tone of fear and a plea for reconsideration.

speaker: WILHELM
text: But we cannot remain idle while the offender roams free. Crusch-sama’s memories, when we defeat the Sin Archbishop, there is a chance they will return. To give up this early, is far too rash.
instruct: Firm and logical, with a calm but resolute tone, emphasizing the chance of returning memories.

speaker: FERRIS
text: Defeating that bastard will bring the memories back? I say, Wilhelm, to think lost memories can be brought back by killing the thing that ate it… Are you daydreaming or do you think this is some kind of fairy tale w―
instruct: Skeptical and dismissive, with a sarcastic tone and a trailing off into disbelief.

speaker: NARRATOR
instruct: Neutral, even narration.

speaker: WILHELM
text: ―Felix!!
instruct: Short and explosive, with a commanding and intense tone.

speaker: NARRATOR
text:
With an ear-splitting roar, the swordsman’s aura resounded in the room. As if a gust of wind had swept in ― was the sensation felt by everyone present.

All wincing from the shock, only Wilhelm’s keen gaze remained intact.
instruct: Neutral, even narration with a dramatic tone, describing the impact of Wilhelm's roar.

speaker: WILHELM
text: Felix… What you said just now. Never utter it again in front of Subaru-dono.
instruct: Authoritative and firm, with a tone of reprimand and a warning to Ferris.

speaker: FERRIS
text: …I’m sorry.
instruct: Humbled and remorseful, with a quiet and apologetic tone.

speaker: NARRATOR
text:
Called by his true name, twice, Ferris closed his eyes with grief and remorse.

The others turned their eyes to Subaru, who was already sitting once more. His hands clenched tightly, faintly trembling, blood seeped through the gaps between his fingers, as if about to cover them whole.
instruct: Narrate with deep sorrow and regret, emphasizing Ferris' emotional weight.

speaker: SUBARU
text: …Emilia-tan.
instruct: Deliver with trembling voice and hesitation, showing Subaru's vulnerability and pain.

speaker: EMILIA
text: Don’t worry… I won’t say anything like «I understand» or «it’s alright»… Even though I want to understand how you feel… that forgotten child… because I don’t understand anything, no matter what I say, it won’t be fair to you…
instruct: Speak with heartfelt sincerity and empathy, conveying Emilia's genuine concern and emotional depth.

speaker: NARRATOR
text:
Subaru looked up, into Emilia’s violet pupils that flickered with sadness. In her eyes he saw a reflection of himself, in all his weakness… is that the Natsuki Subaru she sees?

As if saved by that tender regard, Subaru shook his head.
instruct: Narrate with reflective sadness, highlighting Subaru's emotional struggle and Emilia's compassionate gaze.

speaker: SUBARU
text: To say something like «it’s alright»… even if I rip my mouth apart right now I won’t be able say it. But I am fine. Ferris, don’t worry about it. I… will not give up, as long as there is the tiniest fragment of hope left.
instruct: Deliver with intense determination and resolve, showing Subaru's refusal to give up despite his pain.

speaker: FERRIS
text: Really-nyan… Subaru-kyun sure doesn’t like to give up…
instruct: Speak with a soft, affectionate tone, using playful nicknames to convey Ferris' fondness for Subaru.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Watching Subaru trying to act like he was fine, Ferris’ countenance broke down into a smile. But his position remained unchanged.
instruct: Narrate with subtle emotional contrast, showing Ferris' smile despite his unchanged position.

speaker: FERRIS
text: As for Ferris-nyan, I don’t agree that we should continue the Alliance. I will return Crusch-sama to herself, just watch. So something like vengeance against Gluttony should just be set aside for nyow.
instruct: Speak with firm conviction and a slightly playful tone, expressing Ferris' strong stance on the Alliance.

speaker: WILHELM
text: What we should do, and how… Crusch-sama, you must decide. It is not in our position to do it.
instruct: Narrate with solemn authority, emphasizing Wilhelm's deference to Crusch's decision.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: In the end, it all falls on her. Both their eyes focused upon her, and Crusch, as if understanding, nodded.
instruct: Narrate with quiet admiration, highlighting Crusch's strength and determination despite her amnesia.

speaker: CRUSCH
text: There is still plenty that I do not know. And what I was before, I cannot remember. I want to tell you now, that it will be disorienting, being around me… But even so, I thank you for placing in me your esteem, and trust. And if I could, I want to live up to that expectation. For that, I shall try my best.
instruct: Narrate with contemplative depth, reflecting on the essence of a person and the Alliance's pause.

speaker: NARRATOR
text:
Despite losing her memory, it seemed her strength of character remained.

Just what is the essence of a person? Seeing Crusch like this once more, even after forgetting everything she knew, Subaru could not help but ask himself that question.

But as to the Alliance, there is no better choice than to put the negotiations on hold for now.
instruct: Speak with a calm, logical tone, emphasizing Ferris' insistence on Roswaal's presence for negotiations.

speaker: FERRIS
text: In any case, if the one who holds all the key information concerning Emilia-sama’s faction… Margrave Roswaal isn’t present, then there is nothing we can do-nyan. So for our next negotiation, let’s hold it on the condition that the Margrave be in attendance.
instruct: Deliver with agreement and cautious optimism, showing Crusch's approval of the plan.

speaker: CRUSCH
text: Yes, that is for the best. Then this meeting…
instruct: Speak with a low, secretive tone, emphasizing the need for discretion in the meeting.

speaker: FERRIS
text: Will be a secret ― So pretend it was about something other than an Alliance-nyan.
instruct: Narrate with tense urgency, highlighting Ferris' warning and the gravity of keeping Crusch's condition secret.

speaker: NARRATOR
text:
Ferris shot a sharp glance at Subaru, saying this in an unusually low voice.

Subaru swallowed, but seeing no reason to disagree, he nodded. From their perspective, this decision made sense. If Crusch’s current condition is known to the public, her status as the most competent candidate will vanish.

In fact, the repercussions of Crusch’s amnesia becoming public knowledge is of the same magnitude as the prestige of slaying the White Whale. It is for precisely this reason that Anastasia wasn’t invited to this meeting.
instruct: Narrate with calculated concern, emphasizing the potential threat of Anastasia's knowledge.

speaker: FERRIS
text: Regardless of Julius, Anastasia will certainly use this information to her advantage. Good thing Crusch-sama’s condition hasn’t been seen by those kids of hers.
instruct: Deliver with a mix of concern and urgency, showing Subaru's worry about Anastasia's presence.

speaker: SUBARU
text: …She will be present at the meeting these achievements will be discussed, what do we do about that?
instruct: Speak with a commanding yet reassuring tone, offering a solution and emphasizing the need for secrecy.

speaker: FERRIS
text: We can make an excuse and say she is unwell. Ferris will think of something. As for Subaru-kyun, your side just need to keep this secret, understood?
instruct: Narrate with a tone of quiet resignation, showing the conclusion of the meeting and shared uncertainty.

speaker: NARRATOR
text:
Requesting only silence, Ferris would not allow any further entanglement between their two factions. Subaru, noticing this, only nodded.

In the end, the meeting concluded without any progress whatsoever.

Acknowledging the desperation of their situations, more than anything else, the two factions are aligned in the uncertainty of their futures.

※　※　※　※　※　※　※　※　※　※　※　※　※
instruct: Deliver with genuine gratitude and sincerity, expressing Subaru's appreciation for Wilhelm.

speaker: SUBARU
text: Thank you for back there, Wilhelm-san.
instruct: Narrate with a calm, observational tone, setting the scene for Subaru's conversation with Wilhelm.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: After the meeting in the lounge, Subaru called out to Wilhelm outside the Karsten Mansion. Stopping in his steps, Wilhelm turned to Subaru.
instruct: Deliver with deep humility and self-deprecation, showing Wilhelm's sense of inadequacy.

speaker: WILHELM
text: Not at all. I was of no help, I’m ashamed of how deficient I am. Above all, I was unable to assist you today.
instruct: Deliver with heartfelt sincerity and enthusiasm, expressing Subaru's gratitude and admiration.

speaker: SUBARU
text: Don’t say that, without Wilhelm-san, we wouldn’t have defeated the White Whale. And afterward I was able to entrust Emilia and the villagers to you. I am really really grateful!
instruct: Narrate with reflective warmth, highlighting Subaru's observations of Wilhelm's character.

speaker: NARRATOR
text:
These were unpackaged, genuine words of gratitude. But even this could not lift the gloom from Wilhelm’s face.

Never forgetting a past kindness, always carrying the pain of others within himself. This man… isn’t he too good-natured for his own good? Subaru smiled at the thought.
instruct: Deliver with gentle concern and empathy, showing Subaru's thoughtful inquiry about Wilhelm's well-being.

speaker: SUBARU
text: Even though the situation hasn’t settled yet, have you had a chance to visit your wife’s grave? Even though it’s no consolation, but at least you avenged…
instruct: Speak with a tone of quiet reflection, carrying weight and sorrow.

speaker: NARRATOR
instruct: Neutral, even narration.

speaker: NARRATOR
text:
At Subaru’s words, Wilhelm’s face suddenly collapsed with deep emotion.

Seeing those intertwined waves of grief and sentiment, Subaru didn’t know what to do. Noticing Subaru’s hesitation, Wilhelm bowed deeply.
instruct: Narrate with a calm, observational tone, describing emotional reactions without judgment.

speaker: WILHELM
text: Subaru-dono, I must apologize!
instruct: Deliver with deep remorse and humility, voice trembling slightly.

speaker: SUBARU
text: Wait, don’t be like this, you have nothing to be sorry about, I should be thanking you right now…
instruct: Speak with urgency and concern, voice rising slightly in emotion.

speaker: WILHELM
text: No, that is not true. The words I spoke in the meeting were not out of genuine desire to be your ally. It was my vain, selfish sentiment that made me support the Alliance. For concealing my guilt, I am deeply ashamed.
instruct: Deliver with a heavy, solemn tone, expressing deep guilt and regret.

speaker: NARRATOR
text:
Not understanding Wilhelm’s words, Subaru furrowed his brows.

Seeing this, Wilhelm took off his overcoat, and rolled up his left sleeve – revealing a bandaged wound around his left shoulder. Through the outer cloth one could see that the inner layers are wet with blood.
instruct: Narrate with a neutral, descriptive tone, focusing on the scene and Subaru’s reaction.

speaker: SUBARU
text: Does it hurt? You should get Ferris to look at that.
instruct: Speak with concern and worry, voice tinged with empathy.

speaker: WILHELM
text: This wound cannot be healed. It was dealt by an opponent who possessed the Divine Protection of the Death God.
instruct: Deliver with a calm, factual tone, revealing critical information with measured gravity.

text: Subaru Can’t be healed? …Then, Wilhelm-san!
speaker: SUBARU
instruct: Speak with confusion and disbelief, voice rising in emotional intensity.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Even Subaru knows the outcome of an unhealable wound. Normally, if bleeding can’t be stopped, it’s like a timer being set on one’s life. But unlike Subaru, who looked full of apprehension, Wilhelm shook his head calmly.
instruct: Narrate with a calm, analytical tone, contrasting Subaru’s fear with Wilhelm’s composure.

speaker: WILHELM
text: My life is not in danger right now.
instruct: Deliver with a steady, composed tone, masking inner turmoil with outward calm.

speaker: SUBARU
text: How can that be? That wound… What kind of attack…
instruct: Speak with growing confusion and alarm, voice showing rising tension.

speaker: WILHELM
text: I did not receive this wound today or yesterday. It was from a long time ago, and it recently reopened. But, for me right now, the wound is too large.
instruct: Deliver with a quiet, measured tone, revealing a hidden truth with calm intensity.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Listening to Wilhelm’s quiet words, Subaru’s small body quivered and contracted. Not knowing the reason behind that reaction, even the roots of his teeth felt like they didn’t fit in his jaw. All this came from the Sword Demon in front of him, an incredible aura that could freeze one’s liver solid. Continuing in his calm, gentle voice―.
instruct: Narrate with a tense, ominous tone, emphasizing the weight of Wilhelm’s words.

speaker: WILHELM
text: The effects of a Divine Protection becomes stronger, when the owner of the Divine Protection is near. When the owner of the Divine Protection of the Death God approaches, the wounds they inflicted will open.
instruct: Deliver with a calm, matter-of-fact tone, revealing a shocking revelation with quiet gravity.

What he felt at that moment, he could no longer remember. Everything had turned out so perfectly, so perfect beyond everyone’s expectations ― But the truth is, throwing it all away in that instant, none of it mattered to him.

If he lost Rem, if it meant walking into a future without her, no matter how many times he must endure that pain, he will ―― Only this, Subaru clearly remembers.

Penetrating his throat, in blood, pain, searing heat, and loss, he lost all consciousness.

When he woke, what he saw was Rem lying in a bed.

The save point had moved forward. The place of return had changed. Subaru saw hell, and only hell.

Again! It must be some mistake he must kill himself again… But Subaru hesitated. He was not afraid of pain or death. But he realized…

text: But no more straining yourself. Even though Ferris can squeeze out every toxin from Subaru-kyun’s body, if your gate shatters into a thousand pieces Ferris won’t be able to fix it-nyan. So take the time to properly recover it… about two months-nyan.

text:

speaker: NARRATOR
text:
Subaru apparently appalled by his own remarks, Ferris looked at him rather disinterestedly.

Affected by this reaction, Subaru decided this conversation should be coming to an end. After some thought, he reached out his hand to Ferris.

text: Nyan?

text:
, he started but Subaru held back his words. Even if he doesn’t say it, Ferris already knows. And if he does say it, it will only hurt.
