instruct: Amused and slightly mocking, with a light, teasing tone.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: With those words, her smile hiding behind the hand covering her mouth, Frederica blew it all away. At the question mark floating above Subaru’s head, Frederica bowed, the translucent, golden hair flowing around her face.
instruct: Neutral, even narration.

speaker: FREDERICA
text: I should really be the one apologizing. On Emilia-sama’s request, I have been testing you.
instruct: Neutral, even narration.

speaker: SUBARU
text: Testing?
instruct: Confused and puzzled, with a slightly raised pitch.

speaker: NARRATOR
text:
At Frederica’s words, both Subaru and Emilia tilted their heads. They had no idea what she was talking about.

It’d be fine if Subaru was confused, but if he were to believe her words, then it would be strange to see Emilia showing the same air of confusion as well. Looking at their synchronous response, Frederica’s smile deepened.
instruct: Neutral, even narration.

speaker: FREDERICA
text: Even though I may have been acting according to my sense of duty to protect the mansion, what I did to Subaru-sama was still rude. I was prepared, or rather left with no other choice, but to be relieved of my position after such an act.
instruct: Deliver with a tone of regret and formality, showing remorse for her actions.

speaker: SUBARU
text: No, I think you jumped to that conclusion way too soon. I’m a guy who will understand if we talk things out, right?
instruct: Speak with casual confidence, offering a calm and reasonable response to Frederica’s claim.

speaker: FREDERICA
text: Then, Emilia-sama asserted herself ever so firmly. She really tried so hard, I thought for sure even my face would turn red from the flowery things she was saying about Subaru…
instruct: Narrate with a mix of amusement and slight embarrassment, describing Emilia’s exaggerated behavior.

speaker: SUBARU
text: Wha!?
instruct: React with sudden shock and confusion, expressing disbelief at what was just said.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Shocked by what she had just said, Subaru let out a strangled cry, looking towards Emilia. While Emilia was standing there trying so hard to hide her own deep scarlet countenance.
instruct: Narrate with a vivid description of Subaru’s reaction and Emilia’s flustered state.

speaker: EMILIA
text: Fre–de–ri–ca–!
instruct: Speak with a mix of frustration and exasperation, showing Emilia’s irritation with Frederica.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Hands on her hips, Emilia uncharacteristically let out a hysterical voice, glaring sharply at the maid. On the receiving end of all that, Frederica calmly retorted.
instruct: Narrate with a calm and composed tone, describing Emilia’s reaction and Frederica’s retort.

speaker: FREDERICA
text: Oh my, so scary… I see Emilia-sama hasn’t changed, still not cute at all. Normally, whether what I said was true or not, turning red and getting flustered would have been the prettiest response.
instruct: Speak with a teasing and mocking tone, highlighting Frederica’s playful and sarcastic remarks.

speaker: EMILIA
text: Eh, really…? Wait, I’m not going to get tricked today. Even someone like me, always getting tricked, would learn to know better! That’s right, I know when you’re lying, one of your eyes goes lazy!
instruct: Speak with a mix of determination and slight embarrassment, showing Emilia’s attempt to catch Frederica in a lie.

speaker: FREDERICA
text: I had no idea that was the case. By the way Emilia-sama, did you know that whenever you lie, your ears get a little longer?
instruct: Speak with a playful and teasing tone, revealing Frederica’s counter-accusation about Emilia’s lying.

speaker: EMILIA
text: No way!?
instruct: React with disbelief and surprise, expressing shock at Frederica’s accusation.

speaker: NARRATOR
text:
Emilia’s expression of victory, an arm outstretched and a finger pointing towards Frederica, was interrupted when she darted her hands back to grab both her ears. Getting this response, at that point Frederica’s victory was complete.

Still flustered, Emilia seemed not to have realized she lost, but Subaru, who had been watching her intently, let out a sigh and shrugged his shoulders.
instruct: Narrate with a calm and descriptive tone, capturing the scene of Emilia’s flustered reaction and Subaru’s resignation.

speaker: SUBARU
text: Seems like I’ve been completely defeated… My name is Natsuki Subaru and… Do I even need to do an introduction?
instruct: Speak with a tone of defeat and resignation, showing Subaru’s acknowledgment of his loss.

speaker: FREDERICA
text: Yes, of course. I would love to hear it. Let’s start over and get to know each other properly this time.
instruct: Speak with a calm and calculated tone, masking Frederica’s true intentions behind her polite words.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: With those words, Frederica removed the hand covering her mouth, revealing a smile lined with pointed fangs. This time, seeing her weaponized smile, all the wind left Subaru’s lungs.
instruct: Narrate with a dramatic and slightly ominous tone, describing Frederica’s revealing smile and Subaru’s reaction.

speaker: SUBARU
text: Come to think of it, I think I heard of you… A maid who quit a little while ago before I arrived here, right? I came to the mansion about a month ago… So it’s been three months since you left?
instruct: Speak with a calm and reflective tone, explaining Frederica’s past and her return to the mansion.

speaker: FREDERICA
text: That seems to be right. I had resigned my position due to personal reasons, and I still remember how painfully lonely it felt, leaving here. But it seems that I was able to return much sooner than I expected.
instruct: Narrate with a descriptive and slightly amused tone, highlighting Frederica’s appearance and personality.

speaker: NARRATOR
text:
Covering her mouth with her sleeve, Frederica smiled. As long as she covers her mouth, her beautiful golden hair and her cold, barely passable gaze, would combine into something even resembling feminine beauty. But her mischievous personality and her mouth full of fangs tend to negate that no matter what.

In the living room of the Roswaal Mansion, Subaru and Frederica have just exchanged some basic information beyond their names. Listening to her self-introduction again, he seemed to recall having heard that name before.
instruct: Speak with a curious and slightly suspicious tone, prompting Frederica to explain her connection to Emilia.

speaker: SUBARU
text: Three months ago, so that means you’re acquainted with Emilia-tan, right?
instruct: Speak with a mix of pride and slight irritation, showing Emilia’s reluctant confirmation.

speaker: EMILIA
text: Hrmph! That would be correct, yes.
instruct: Speak with a teasing and slightly mocking tone, commenting on Emilia’s behavior.

speaker: SUBARU
text: Who even goes «Hrmph» like that, these days? Also sulking like that is so outdated it’s cute, man.
instruct: Narrate with a descriptive and slightly amused tone, capturing Emilia’s reaction to Subaru’s comment.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: To Subaru’s question and gaze, Emilia sat down onto the couch, averting her eyes as if refraining from joining the conversation, though she was obviously still listening intently. She had been acting like this ever since she realized, too late, how Frederica had tricked her. But that aside,
instruct: Narrate with a calm and observational tone, describing the situation and Subaru’s question.

speaker: SUBARU
text: It’s only been two or three days since you returned, right? We left from the village three days ago… Four, if you count the traveling time. It seems to be quite a coincidence.
instruct: Speak with a calm and slightly surprised tone, explaining Frederica’s return and the letter.

speaker: FREDERICA
text: I was surprised too when I returned to the mansion to find it empty. Luckily, there was a letter explaining things in the master’s study, so I avoided the worst of the confusion.
instruct: React with curiosity and confusion, prompting Frederica to explain the letter.

speaker: SUBARU
text: A letter?
instruct: Speak with a casual and inquisitive tone, asking Frederica about the letter.

speaker: FREDERICA
text: Yes, from Ram. She was the one who called me back to the mansion, though she was rather haphazard in her communication… I know it’s indulging her too much to pass it off as her personality, but that’s how I feel.
instruct: Delivered with a mix of fondness and slight exasperation, as if recalling a well-meaning but clumsy friend.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Through Frederica’s half-awkward smile, Subaru saw the time-worn bond she and Ram must have shared, and all the wonderful days they have passed together. At the same time, erased from her memories, her time spent with Rem must have been just as long.
instruct: Neutral, even narration.

speaker: SUBARU
text: Could you tell me why Ram called you back?
instruct: Curious and direct, with a slight edge of concern.

speaker: FREDERICA
text: I don’t completely understand the reason myself. But Emilia-sama was here at the time, I am sure she would know.
instruct: Humble and deferential, with a hint of uncertainty.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: At once, both their gazes poured onto Emilia inquisitively. Even now, Emilia continued to maintain her
instruct: Neutral, even narration.

text: I’m still really, really angry
speaker: EMILIA
instruct: Frustrated and emphatic, with a tone of lingering irritation.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: attitude, turning her face away. But, as she slowly became unable to resist the attention focused on her, she tried to steal a quick glance in their direction. Only, it ended up being a rather obvious glance.
instruct: Neutral, even narration.

speaker: SUBARU
text: Emilia-tan, cheer up… Or, actually, I’m not the one who upset you this time. Frederica, apologize properly would you?
instruct: Warm and slightly teasing, with a tone of reassurance.

speaker: FREDERICA
text: I ask for your forgiveness, Emilia-sama. What I did a moment ago was not nice and I apologize. I was so happy we could meet again after so long, my bad side just, slipped out.
instruct: Sincere and apologetic, with a touch of embarrassment.

speaker: EMILIA
text: …You won’t tease me like that anymore?
instruct: Skeptical and cautious, with a soft, questioning tone.

speaker: FREDERICA
text: No, I will refrain from doing so. For all the world, I will never again tease Emilia-sama in that manner again.
instruct: Resolute and earnest, with a tone of complete sincerity.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Subaru couldn’t quite get rid of the feeling that the wording of Frederica’s apology left some room for interpretation. However, our Goddess Emilia seemed to believe in those words without a second thought, and her up-to-now sulking expression relaxed into one that seemed to say,
instruct: Neutral, even narration.

text: I suppose it can’t be helped
speaker: EMILIA
instruct: Resigned and slightly weary, with a tone of reluctant acceptance.

speaker: NARRATOR
instruct: Neutral, even narration.

speaker: EMILIA
text: I understand. I’m not angry anymore. Is that good enough?
instruct: Calm and composed, with a tone of quiet understanding.

speaker: FREDERICA
text: Yes, I am very sorry for before, Emilia-sama. ――Too easy.
instruct: Sarcastic and dry, with a hint of amusement.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Somehow, only Subaru heard that last part. He jerked his head to look at Frederica, but she was playing dumb. Emilia, who had no idea she was being considered
instruct: Neutral, even narration.

text: too easy
speaker: SUBARU
instruct: Neutral, even narration.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: , placed a finger to her cheek and said,
instruct: Neutral, even narration.

speaker: EMILIA
text: So, let’s see. The reason Frederica was called back to the mansion… Umm.
instruct: Confident and slightly smug, with a tone of self-assurance.

speaker: SUBARU
text: Yeah, yeah. Rushing to call back someone you fired would mean there’s some kind of emergency… Actually, I think I might have an idea.
instruct: Neutral, even narration.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: There was indeed an emergency, it was only a few days ago that the Mansion and Arlam Village were targeted by the Witch Cult. Considering her skill, which had been able to knock Subaru unconscious in an instant, Frederica must be another shady maid of the Roswaal Mansion with some crazy combat abilities. In short, Ram must have called her back to buff the mansion’s defenses during their state of―.
instruct: Calm and matter-of-fact, with a tone of quiet amusement.

speaker: EMILIA
text: It was because Ram’s aptitude for housework is catastrophic, and the mansion ended up in an unimaginable state of disarray. It was only a few days, but it kept getting harder and harder to live in.
instruct: Passionate and exasperated, with a tone of disbelief.

speaker: SUBARU
text: That’s actually a very compelling reason!! She really is all talk and no… Wait, Ram knows she’s hopeless, she even said so herself! She’s right about that at least, but then she should have put in some effort to improve!! Right!?
instruct: Neutral, even narration.

speaker: NARRATOR
text:
Subaru’s chest felt like it would explode from how compelling that reality was compared to his over-guessing of the situation.

Emilia let out a wry smile at his outburst, and shifted her gaze to the living room― Or rather, to the entirety of the mansion, as though she could see through its very walls.
instruct: Calm and reflective, with a tone of quiet observation.

speaker: EMILIA
text: But, since Frederica returned, the mansion really has become quite tidy. I think Ram made the right decision in leaving it to someone capable, rather than make things worse by ignoring it.
instruct: Emilia speaks with a calm, composed tone, slightly amused but carrying a hint of underlying concern.

speaker: SUBARU
text: Emilia-tan, I don’t think you meant it, but that statement’s like a slap to the face! And, well, I still don’t think that’s a good enough reason for her to give up so easily.
instruct: Subaru's voice is sharp with indignation, his tone tinged with hurt and frustration.

speaker: FREDERICA
text: Putting Ram’s assessment aside for the moment, it has been such a long time since I have been given the opportunity to do some really worthwhile work. Luckily, since no one was around, I was able to spend the time on further cleaning the mansion.
instruct: Frederica speaks with a poised, measured tone, her words precise and self-assured.

speaker: NARRATOR
text:
Listening to Frederica speak of diligently holding up this household, Subaru held his breath, unable to ignore the pain wrenching in his heart.

For this was the forces of the world compensating for the eradication of Rem’s existence by the Authority of Gluttony.
instruct: Narrator delivers the line with a somber, reflective tone, emphasizing the emotional weight of the moment.

speaker: SUBARU
text: I guess since Ram can’t run the mansion by herself, the obvious solution was to rely on someone else…
instruct: Subaru's voice is weary, his tone carrying a mix of resignation and reluctant acceptance.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: So Ram had contacted Frederica, who had resigned, asking her to return to the mansion. Without Rem, the Roswaal estate couldn’t continue to function, and so, Rem’s replacement, Frederica, had arrived.
instruct: Narrator speaks with a tone of quiet revelation, highlighting the gravity of the situation.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Yet, the only one in the world who knows of this sad truth is Subaru. Ram had only done as necessity demanded, without stopping to think about why she needed Frederica’s help all of a sudden, or just how she had managed to take care of the estate until then. That was all there was to it. But,
instruct: Narrator delivers the line with a tone of solemn realization, underscoring the emotional burden on Subaru.

speaker: SUBARU
text: Sorry for being serious all of a sudden but… is it a requirement for all the maids of Roswaal’s Mansion to be so quirky?
instruct: Subaru's voice is laced with dry humor, his tone slightly sarcastic and bemused.

speaker: FREDERICA
text: …? Considering who our master is, what’s the point of even asking that question?
instruct: Frederica's voice is cool and composed, her tone carrying a subtle edge of amusement.

speaker: SUBARU
text: That’s annoyingly persuasive!
instruct: Subaru's voice is surprised, his tone tinged with admiration and mild exasperation.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: At this point, all of Subaru’s doubts have been answered. Seeing his response, Frederica nodded her head contentedly, and resuming her perfect posture, stared fixedly at Subaru. Then, casually, in a lowered voice,
instruct: Narrator delivers the line with a calm, observational tone, setting the stage for the next exchange.

speaker: FREDERICA
text: By the way, the driver of the dragon carriage outside the mansion has been left out there for over an hour now… Is that alright?
instruct: Frederica's voice is composed and slightly pointed, her tone carrying a hint of mild reprimand.

speaker: SUBARU
text: Hmm? Oh, you mean Otto. I see, it’s already been an hour… Well, I don’t think it’s that big of an issue. I want to hurry and let Patrasche rest in the stable, but you don’t need to pay attention to that Otto guy too much…
instruct: Subaru's voice is dismissive, his tone casual and slightly apologetic.

speaker: OTTO
text: Having shared a near-death experience together as companions, that is really quite heartless, Natsuki-san! I never thought I was lower in priority than a ground dragon!
instruct: Otto's voice is dramatic and indignant, his tone full of exaggerated outrage.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Right on cue, Otto dramatically opened the doors to the living room. His shoulders hunched up angrily, he was glaring at Subaru while disapprovingly breathing through his nostrils. At his entrance, Subaru slowly stood up, shook his head, and sighed.
instruct: Narrator delivers the line with a calm, observational tone, describing Otto's entrance and Subaru's reaction.

speaker: SUBARU
text: No, Otto, you’re mistaken.
instruct: Subaru's voice is firm but slightly exasperated, his tone carrying a hint of dry humor.

speaker: OTTO
text: How am I mistaken? It’s too late to take back your words from a moment ago…
instruct: Otto's voice is incredulous, his tone filled with exaggerated frustration.

speaker: SUBARU
text: It’s not that you’re lower in priority than a ground dragon. It’s that you are much, much lower in priority than a ground dragon.
instruct: Subaru's voice is teasing, his tone laced with playful sarcasm.

speaker: OTTO
text: That’s twice over! That’s even worse!
instruct: Otto's voice is dramatically upset, his tone filled with exaggerated bitterness.

speaker: NARRATOR
text:
Content with Otto’s response and foot-stomping, Subaru turned his gaze toward the window. That is, toward the front yard where the dragon carriage pulled by Patrasche was parked.

Otto followed his gaze and seemed to understand its meaning. With a still somewhat bitter face, he spoke,
instruct: Narrator delivers the line with a calm, observational tone, setting the scene for Otto's next statement.

speaker: OTTO
text: I’ve already put Patrasche in the stables. She is a proud and difficult child, but she didn’t want to cause Natsuki-san any trouble, so she was quite docile.
instruct: Otto's voice is matter-of-fact, his tone carrying a hint of pride and slight defensiveness.

speaker: SUBARU
text: Hearing that from you, it makes me doubt your Divine Protection of the Soul of Language¹⁰. If she were a woman, Patrasche would have been a total kuudere¹¹, even though she’d be soft on the inside. When did this change happen?
instruct: Subaru's voice is incredulous, his tone laced with playful teasing and mild confusion.

speaker: OTTO
text: How would I know that kind of thing. More importantly…
instruct: Otto's voice is dismissive, his tone carrying a hint of irritation and impatience.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: As Subaru was still struggling to understand just what made Patrasche so devoted to him, Otto moved the conversation to the other matter regarding the dragon carriage, that is―.
instruct: Narrator delivers the line with a calm, observational tone, setting the stage for Otto's next statement.

speaker: OTTO
text: What should be done about the girl sleeping in the carriage? I think it’s rather pitiful to leave her shut up in there. If you are busy, I could carry her to a room…
instruct: Otto's voice is concerned, his tone carrying a mix of empathy and slight urgency.

speaker: SUBARU
text: ―Don’t you lay a finger on Rem.
instruct: Firm, protective tone with a hint of urgency.

speaker: NARRATOR
text:
There was not a hint of malice in Otto’s proposal. But his own voice was ice cold… Subaru himself was surprised by the razor sharpness of it, when he saw Otto flinch.

It was almost a whisper, the words were low and dark, a reflection of the viscous heaviness of his mind. It was good that this did not reach the ears of the girls, but still, Subaru was deeply disturbed by the abnormality of the sound that had escaped his throat.
instruct: Neutral, even narration with a subtle emphasis on Otto's coldness.

speaker: SUBARU
text: …I’ll bring her in, so you don’t have to do anything. Your back would be screaming if you had to carry around a girl anyway.
instruct: Casual, slightly sarcastic delivery with a touch of concern.

speaker: OTTO
text: You know, merchants are always handling heavier goods during their work. We aren’t as weak as you seem to think, Natsuki-san.
instruct: Confident, calm voice with a slight edge of condescension.

speaker: NARRATOR
text:
Subaru tried to cover up his last statement with a quip, and was thankful for Otto’s conciliatory reply, which came after a moment of hesitation. He let out a sigh.

No matter what, his reaction was too extreme. Even though it wasn’t intentional ― Or rather, it was precisely because it was not intentional that it was a problem. His nerves had been on-end, and anyone who even tries to interfere with Rem, regardless of their intentions, seemed to him to be an enemy.
instruct: Neutral, even narration with a reflective, introspective tone.

speaker: SUBARU
text: This is not a good pattern… Damn it, I feel so wretched. Why am I always so…
instruct: Frustrated, self-deprecating tone with a sense of despair.

speaker: NARRATOR
text:
He was supposed to have overcome this, yet here he was immediately stumbling over the first pebble he came across. Why does he never have the strength to stay standing tall?

If Rem was here, if Emilia was watching ― If both of them were here now with him, surely, he would have that unwavering strength.
instruct: Neutral, even narration with a somber, reflective mood.

speaker: SUBARU
text: I brought it upon myself… No, I forced Rem to pay that price. What a deadbeat I am!
instruct: Guilt-ridden, self-critical tone with a heavy sense of regret.

speaker: NARRATOR
text:
There should have been a better, more perfect way.

He had believed that he did his uttermost, up to the end of the loop several days ago he deeply believed that. But there must have been an even better, seamless, perfect outcome somewhere. But Subaru had missed his chance to find it, in his complacency, in his cowardice, he compromised into an imperfect future. And Rem’s sacrifice was the price.

If he had been more competent, he would have noticed it.

Before evacuating Emilia and Ram from the mansion, the handwritten letter he had given to Crusch’s messenger had already turned blank. He had thought that a Witch Cultist accompanying the messenger had switched the letter in a ploy to sow confusion, but that is laughable.

There was no chance the Witch Cult could have been aware of their threat, and how could he have believed that the Witch Cult would use such a roundabout way to plant seeds of distrust between their two forces? More than that, if they went to all this trouble, compared to a blank letter would it not have been more effective to alter the contents?

Then why, why was the handwritten letter blank? If it was not the work of the Witch Cult, then there could only be one answer.
instruct: Neutral, even narration with a tone of deep introspection and regret.

speaker: SUBARU
text: Rem wrote the letter. I was the one who asked it to be delivered, and Crusch was the one who gave it to the messenger, so the reality of it being handed over remained, and only the contents were erased.
instruct: Resolute, determined tone with a sense of clarity and purpose.

speaker: NARRATOR
text:
That is the Authority of Gluttony, and the fate of those whose name and memories were eaten. An existence erased from the world, leaving only a complex web of incongruities behind. If you weren’t aware of it, you’d never feel the unease, you’d never even realize anything had been missing.

If that was the case, for who, or for what, would have been the purpose of that existence―.

Looking deeper into the fact that the letter was blank, properly investigating, fathoming, delving into the truth, perhaps he could have done it.

What Emilia had said then, come to think of it, the letter had arrived on the evening before the final day. At that moment, the contents of the letter were already gone, then Rem would have been attacked before that time. If so, then hardly any time had passed since Subaru and Rem had parted ways. The chances of being able to catch up were minuscule, but at least there was a chance.

Only, Subaru had let that chance slip by. Why it had slipped by, he could no longer tell. Had he really not felt anything was out of place?

Ram, with her sister-complex, Emilia, who was aware they had left Rem with him in the Royal Capital, yet they had not mentioned Rem at all, so why―.
instruct: Neutral, even narration with a tone of ominous realization and dread.

speaker: SUBARU
text: ―Ah.
instruct: Startled, abrupt tone with a hint of confusion and shock.

speaker: NARRATOR
text:
He finally realized it.

At that moment, Subaru let out an idiotic cry and brought his hand to his forehead. With wobbly movements he slid over to the wall, and smashed his head as hard as he could against it.

Shock and pain. But once wasn’t enough, again, again, and again he repeated.
instruct: Neutral, even narration with a tone of concern and bewilderment.

speaker: EMILIA
text: Wh, Subaru!?
instruct: Surprised, concerned tone with a sense of urgency.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: At his inexplicable action, the three with him were shocked into speechlessness. But Emilia was first to return to her senses, and called out to him bewilderedly. She gripped his shoulder from behind, turning him around,
instruct: Neutral, even narration with a tone of gentle concern and confusion.

speaker: EMILIA
text: What’s wrong all of a sudden? It’s not like this is the first time you’ve done something strange, but this is… Oh―, look your forehead has gotten all red!
instruct: Self-deprecating, apologetic tone with a sense of shame and regret.

speaker: SUBARU
text: The extent of my stupidity, from the bottom of my heart I am amazed, really.
instruct: Neutral, even narration with a tone of emotional intensity and focus.

speaker: NARRATOR
text:
Feeling the coolness of the tips of Emilia’s fingers on his forehead, Subaru shook away his head in a trance of self-loathing. Like he said, he could not bear to look at this own foolishness.

Then, suddenly drawing close to Emilia, Subaru fixed his gaze into hers.
instruct: Slightly awkward, earnest tone with a hint of nervousness.

speaker: SUBARU
text: Emilia-tan, I have a favor to ask.
instruct: Startled, confused tone with a sense of discomfort.

speaker: EMILIA
text: Wh, wha―? Hold on, Subaru, your face is close, and your eyes are scaring me…
instruct: Slightly awkward, hesitant tone with a hint of embarrassment.

speaker: SUBARU
text: My helpless idiocy… Could you please insult me a little?
instruct: Frustrated, desperate tone with a sense of urgency.

speaker: EMILIA
text: Huh?
instruct: Neutral, even narration with a tone of tension and emotional intensity.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Startled, Emilia grew wide-eyed. Seeing rejection in her response, Subaru reached out to place both hands on her shoulders, holding her tightly preventing her from running away, and then brought his face in even closer.
instruct: Desperate, pleading tone with a sense of emotional urgency.

speaker: SUBARU
text: Please. Don’t forgive me, just insult me.
instruct: Hesitant, uncertain tone with a sense of reassurance.

speaker: EMILIA
text: Th, that, I can’t do that. I don’t think you’ve done wrong or anything…
instruct: Desperate, frantic tone with a sense of urgency and desperation.

speaker: SUBARU
text: Just find a way!!!!
instruct: Urgent and desperate, with a tone of intense determination.

speaker: EMILIA
text: Even if you ask me that…
instruct: Hesitant and conflicted, with a slight edge of discomfort.

speaker: SUBARU
text: Please! If you do this for me, I’ll offer you my very soul…!
instruct: Desperate and pleading, with a dramatic and heartfelt tone.

speaker: EMILIA
text: Saying something this heavy is only making me more uncomfortable! Geez, I guess I really don’t have a choice.
instruct: Annoyed and exasperated, with a hint of reluctant agreement.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Emilia hesitated agonizingly against Subaru’s desperate, perverse plea, but finally she nodded in resignation. She cleared her throat and looked up at Subaru.
instruct: Neutral, even narration with a focus on descriptive action.

speaker: EMILIA
text: Subaru you blockhead!
instruct: Frustrated and exasperated, with a sharp and scolding tone.

speaker: SUBARU
text: Uuu―
instruct: Startled and confused, with a short and hesitant vocalization.

speaker: NARRATOR
instruct: Neutral, even narration.

He still hadn’t had time to process his conversation with Beatrice. The sad expression on her face at the very end, he had no idea of how to even begin to make sense of it.
instruct: Neutral, even narration with a slight introspective tone.

speaker: SUBARU
text: By the way, where’s Frederica gone off to? How could her good judgment be so lacking that she would leave my Emilia-tan and Otto alone together…
instruct: Slightly defensive and dismissive, with a tone of mild irritation.

speaker: EMILIA
text: Setting aside the matter of me supposedly belonging to anyone for another time… Frederica has gone off to prepare one of the guest rooms… Since we’re going to need a place for Rem-san to rest.
instruct: Slightly apologetic and hesitant, with a tone of reluctant agreement.

speaker: SUBARU
text: Ah, I see.
instruct: Neutral, even narration with a slight introspective tone.

speaker: NARRATOR
text:
Subaru responded in a low whisper. Emilia, looking pained, narrowed her eyes.

While he hated himself for causing this expression on her face, he simply couldn’t hold back the rending pain filling up his chest every time he was reminded of Rem. However, with a blink and a shake of his head, he extinguished the grief from his expression to keep his pain from extending to Emilia. Relaxing his lips, he said,
instruct: Determined and concerned, with a tone of urgent resolve.

speaker: SUBARU
text: In that case, I better get Rem from the dragon carriage. She shouldn’t be lying out there all alone… Oh, sorry about what I said before, Otto.
instruct: Slightly apologetic and hesitant, with a tone of reluctant explanation.

speaker: OTTO
text: No, no, I don’t blame you. After all, I sense that… a lot has happened between her and Natsuki-san. I can hardly ask you to have your emotions in check given the circumstances.
instruct: Slightly defensive and dismissive, with a tone of mild irritation.

speaker: SUBARU
text: It’s just that when I think of you touching my Rem with your dirty, money-grubbing hands, I can’t help myself… I’m really sorry.
instruct: Defiant and exasperated, with a tone of strong denial.

speaker: OTTO
text: There’s no way you’d say something like that if you were really sorry! I also really don’t think that’s a line a person who just labelled a totally different girl as his should be saying!!
instruct: Slightly defensive and dismissive, with a tone of mild irritation.

speaker: SUBARU
text: That’s just me using you in my plan to make Emilia-tan fall jealously in love with me. Don’t make me say it out loud, idiot.
instruct: Slightly exasperated and dismissive, with a tone of mild irritation.

speaker: OTTO
text: You said that out loud all on your own!!
instruct: Neutral, even narration with a slight introspective tone.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Grinning at Otto’s reliably explosive reaction, Subaru snuck a glance at Emilia’s face. Having been intently observing their exchange, Emilia’s lips seemed to soften just a little, and the sorrow of moments ago had all disappeared. Confirming this, Subaru drew a small sigh of relief.
instruct: Neutral, even narration.

speaker: EMILIA
text: Subaru and Otto-kun seem to be reeaally close. Even though you only met just recently…
instruct: Emilia speaks with a warm, slightly teasing tone, hinting at her growing affection.

speaker: SUBARU
text: Huh, that’s what you got jealous at!? Compared to my feelings for you, Otto is just a toy, a plaything on the side! I want a real and passionate relationship with you, Emilia-tan!
instruct: Subaru speaks with exaggerated passion and possessiveness, his voice tinged with jealousy.

speaker: OTTO
text: Why am I the one being discarded!? Even though this whole thing has no basis in reality, I still really don’t like that!!
instruct: Otto speaks with indignation and hurt, his voice rising in frustration.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Seeing the two guys heat up more and more, Emilia suddenly burst out laughing. Covering her mouth with her hand, her shoulders shuddering with laughter, Emilia managed to squeeze out an
instruct: Neutral, even narration.

text: I’m sorry
speaker: EMILIA
instruct: Emilia speaks softly, her voice laced with genuine apology and amusement.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: before she was finally able to continue.
instruct: Neutral, even narration.

speaker: EMILIA
text: I don’t think this is the kind of situation where I should be laughing like this, but I just can’t help myself… Are you sure you two haven’t actually known each other for a really long time?
instruct: Emilia speaks with a mix of amusement and curiosity, her tone light and playful.

speaker: SUBARU
text: He’s a travelling merchant you know? Once his business is over, he’ll be out of here before you know it… Actually, just the thought of an unshipped male character other than myself coming near Emilia-tan, aaah I can’t stand it!
instruct: Subaru speaks with intense jealousy and possessiveness, his voice full of dramatic flair.

speaker: OTTO
text: I don’t know what that is, but in the short time I’ve gotten to know you I can already tell it’s probably something really awful, so I don’t like it――!
instruct: Otto speaks with confusion and mild frustration, his tone tinged with sarcasm.

speaker: NARRATOR
text:
Seeing Otto putting his hands on his head with a somewhat traumatized expression on his face, Subaru snorted loudly, twisting his mouth.

In a way, those exaggerations were actually his true feelings. Ever since baring his heart to Emilia, Subaru chased her with an air of indomitable invincibility, and his heart is set ablaze with jealousy whenever another guy approaches her. This is surely because the depth of his possessiveness, and jealousy, are both many times that of any normal person.

※　※　※　※　※　※　※　※　※　※　※　※　※

The rampant conversation in the living room was coming to an end just as Frederica returned from preparing the guest room.
instruct: Neutral, even narration.

speaker: OTTO
text: I was thinking, I’d like to check on how things are in the village nearby. Since I’m holding onto the certificates for the other merchants regarding the purchasing of their cargo, I can, to an extent, take care of distributing things to the village. Though I’ll get the Margrave to pay for the costs later, of course.
instruct: Otto speaks with a calm, calculated tone, masking his genuine concern for the village.

speaker: NARRATOR
text:
After saying this, as if the fatigue from the long trip did not affect him at all, Otto hustled off towards the village.

No matter how much he showed the face of a calculative merchant, his proposal was, as 60% of the evacuees had not yet returned, nothing short of aid and support for the still nonfunctional Arlam Village. Watching Otto hide all this behind a money-hungry demeanor, Subaru was forced to quickly cover up his sense of gratitude by pretending to spit on the ground.
instruct: Neutral, even narration.

speaker: FREDERICA
text: I have prepared a room in the servants’ quarters as instructed… Strangely, there was only one room that appeared to have been thoroughly cleaned.
instruct: Frederica speaks with a calm, slightly puzzled tone, her voice measured and polite.

speaker: SUBARU
text: Thoroughly cleaned… The innermost room on the second floor?
instruct: Subaru speaks with a hesitant, almost fearful tone, his voice low and uncertain.

speaker: FREDERICA
text: ―Yes, that’s right. Only that room seemed clean, as if everything had been thrown out except the bed… Do you, know something about it?
instruct: Frederica speaks with a calm, knowing tone, her voice tinged with quiet understanding.

speaker: NARRATOR
text:
As Frederica spoke of the room she had just prepared, Subaru struggled hard to keep his grief from emerging in his eyes.

The room she talked about ―― The innermost room on the Mansion’s second floor in the eastern wing, was the room Rem had used. Hearing the explanation that everything in the room must have been tidied up, Subaru deeply felt the overwhelming power of Gluttony’s Authority eradication of existence.
instruct: Neutral, even narration.

speaker: SUBARU
text: …No. I just had a hunch, there’s no real meaning behind it.
instruct: Subaru speaks with a strained, almost forced tone, his voice betraying his hidden grief.

speaker: NARRATOR
text:
Frederica, who saw the truth behind Subaru’s words, didn’t say a thing.

She too, seemed to possess an extraordinarily excellent disposition as a maid. Most likely, Rem and Frederica were the two who had kept Roswaal’s overly spacious mansion functioning… Ram doesn’t count.

Going around back of the Mansion, a soft snorting sound greeted Subaru as he headed towards the dragon carriage.

Looking at where the carriage was parked, he saw an unfamiliar building that looked like a storehouse ―― most likely it was the place used to shelter dragon carriages, like a garage. He saw the building, and Patrasche stabled in the adjacent barn. The ground dragon with jet black skin let out a valiant cry, extending her neck out towards the approaching Subaru in a gesture of tenderness. Placing a fingertip against the approaching nostrils, he tickled the rough skin.
instruct: Neutral, even narration.

speaker: SUBARU
text: Sorry I never thanked you properly, Patrasche. A lot of things happened, and I know it’s late, but I’m counting on you from here on out too, partner.
instruct: Subaru speaks with sincerity and gratitude, his voice warm and heartfelt.

speaker: NARRATOR
instruct: Neutral, even narration.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: In answer to Subaru’s words, Patrasche licked the palm of his hand with her rough tongue. Looking at their friendly exchange, Frederica tilted her head.
instruct: Neutral, even narration.

speaker: FREDERICA
text: She really cherishes you. One look, and anyone could tell she is a competent ground dragon, yet to see how tamed she is… It’s astounding.
instruct: Frederica speaks with admiration and genuine surprise, her tone warm and approving.

speaker: SUBARU
text: I haven’t done anything close to taming her? If normal ground dragons are difficult to pet and hug, then I guess it’s just because Patrasche has a deeper emotional capacity than the others. Or, maybe I’m just so incapable, she can’t leave me be.
instruct: Subaru speaks with self-deprecating humor, his voice tinged with humility and affection.

speaker: NARRATOR
text:
It’s not like Subaru was being humble, it was simply the only way he could appraise Patrasche’s loveliness. Within just three or four days from meeting her, how many times had he had his life saved by this soft-hearted ground dragon. Conversely, Subaru hadn’t done anything for her in return yet. He couldn’t help but think his meeting with this ground dragon was nothing short of a blessing.

As though understanding Subaru’s self-assessment, Patrasche extended her head, which was licking Subaru’s hands, and rubbed her muzzle against the inattentive Subaru’s cheek. Surprised at the sudden offensive, Subaru smiled wryly at the raspy sensation on his face.
instruct: Neutral, even narration.

speaker: FREDERICA
text: I think I understood what kind of person Subaru-sama is. ―You, have your own hardships.
instruct: Delivered with a calm, reflective tone, showing understanding and empathy.

speaker: NARRATOR
instruct: Neutral, even narration.

speaker: NARRATOR
text:
Instead of Subaru, who had his hands full with Patrasche, Frederica’s words and kind gaze were directed at Patrasche, who was frolicking with him. Patrasche stopped her movements for a moment at the deep emotion behind Frederica’s words, looking at her with the pupils of a reptile, before resuming her toying of Subaru.

In that moment, the women somehow understood each other, and Subaru was completely unaware. Anyways,
instruct: Neutral, even narration with a subtle emphasis on the emotional connection between characters.

speaker: SUBARU
text: Sorry for making you wait, Rem. I’m sure it was cramped and dark, right? I’m gonna carry you to your room now, okay?
instruct: Apologetic and gentle, with a soft, caring tone.

speaker: NARRATOR
text:
After spending some time playing with Patrasche, he headed for where the dragon carriage was parked ―― in other words, to where Rem had been left sleeping.

There was no change, Rem was still in a deep sleep. She didn’t raise any objections. Sulking at being left behind, her head turned away, cheeks puffed out saying
instruct: Neutral, even narration with a focus on Subaru's actions and the setting.

text: Subaru-kun is so mean!
speaker: REM
instruct: Petulant and childish, with a tone of mild frustration and hurt feelings.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: or laughing at Subaru’s apology ― None of that will happen.
instruct: Neutral, even narration with a slight pause for effect.

speaker: FREDERICA
text: ―I heard about it earlier, but still I am surprised.
instruct: Calm and composed, with a tone of quiet observation.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: From behind Subaru, who was immersed in nostalgia, Frederica, who saw Rem for the first time, was unable to hide her surprise. When Subaru tilted his head at Frederica’s surprised response, she quietly shook her head.
instruct: Neutral, even narration with a focus on the visual and emotional details.

speaker: FREDERICA
text: Nothing. It is just, her face looks very similar to the Ram I know. The only difference I see is the color of the hair… Twins, as you said.
instruct: Calm and composed, with a tone of quiet observation and mild surprise.

speaker: SUBARU
text: I’m sure it must be hard to believe, what with losing your memories and all, but I’m glad you believed me. It would make me glad if you remembered her, without thinking it was some kind of cruel joke.
instruct: Sincere and heartfelt, with a tone of deep emotional investment.

speaker: NARRATOR
text:
Nodding at the reason for Frederica’s surprise, Subaru stretched his palm out to touch Rem’s cheek. Somehow, he felt no warmth nor coldness. There was no doubt all her life-functions were active, but there was nothing left living within her.

Confirming what he had already checked countless times, Subaru again received an incurable wound to the depths of his heart. Even knowing this, he still could not help but check.
instruct: Neutral, even narration with a focus on the emotional weight of the scene.

speaker: FREDERICA
text: Subaru-sama. It would be fine for me to carry…
instruct: Polite and respectful, with a tone of quiet offer and concern.

speaker: SUBARU
text: I want to do it. Please let me. I want to be the one that takes Rem to the Mansion… to her room. Sorry I’m being selfish.
instruct: Passionate and earnest, with a tone of strong emotional conviction.

speaker: FREDERICA
text: Not at all, it’s really touching. Your eyes look like those of a murderer, but you are kind, I see.
instruct: Calm and composed, with a tone of dry, observational humor.

speaker: SUBARU
text: I also have a heart that gets damaged from such casual dissing!
instruct: Neutral, even narration with a focus on the emotional and physical weight of the moment.

speaker: NARRATOR
text:
Responding to Frederica’s words, Subaru wrapped Rem up in his arms. He has carried her several times now to move her, but even so he was reminded of how light she was.

It was with this body she had stood in front of him, fighting hard to protect his useless self. The more he dwelt on this, the more he thought of just how precious she is to him.
instruct: Sincere and heartfelt, with a tone of deep emotional vulnerability.

speaker: SUBARU
text: I’ll wake you, as soon as I can. So, please, scold me angrily for feeling the softness of your body with these fingertips of mine.
instruct: Playful and slightly teasing, with a tone of lighthearted banter.

speaker: FREDERICA
text: It was such a good line, until you had to go and ruin it.
instruct: Calm and composed, with a tone of dry, observational humor.

speaker: NARRATOR
text:
Subaru exited the dragon carriage, leaving Frederica’s disgruntled words behind him.

He nodded a quick goodbye to Patrasche, who had poked her head out of the stables. Subaru then entered the mansion, led by Frederica. Led to the room on the eastern wing ―― The bedroom, the room that once was Rem’s.
instruct: Neutral, even narration with a focus on the setting and movement.

speaker: FREDERICA
text: You talked, with Beatrice-sama.
instruct: Calm and composed, with a tone of quiet curiosity and concern.

speaker: NARRATOR
text:
The statement was thrown out abruptly, as they walked.

Subaru, who had been carefully going up the stairs, looked up at Frederica’s back. She narrowed the pupils of her sharp eyes and looked back down at Subaru with a gaze that held only intimidation. Although, Subaru understood it was only a misunderstanding, as he had the same kind of eyes, with more white area than was usual.

Coming to the correct assumption that his silence was affirmation at her question, Frederica said,
instruct: Neutral, even narration with a focus on the emotional and visual details.

speaker: FREDERICA
text: Is she doing well? I ask because, since my return to the Mansion, I have yet to see her face.
instruct: Calm and composed, with a tone of quiet curiosity and concern.

speaker: SUBARU
text: I already told Emilia-tan, but she was doing ok… I guess. Though, I couldn’t talk to her as much as I normally do, since she was in a worse mood than usual.
instruct: Skeptical and reserved, with a tone of quiet doubt and contemplation.

speaker: FREDERICA
text: Is… that so.
instruct: Neutral, even narration with a focus on the emotional and narrative weight of the scene.

speaker: NARRATOR
text:
As though anxious, her expression at Subaru’s answer was not a bright one.

Seeing that look, Subaru couldn’t help but wonder about something. It was about what the role of the girl named Beatrice actually was in the Mansion. Up until now, Subaru had not dug deep into her position or background.

The girl, in the mansion of Margrave Roswaal, stayed in a mysterious magical space, the Forbidden Library, and was treated by Rem and Ram as both guest and nobility.

Then again, she seems to childishly adore Puck, a spirit contracted to Emilia, a candidate for the Royal Selection, as though he were an older brother. Also, the way she behaved towards Subaru seemed appropriate for her age, though her actions during their last encounter――they were all mysteries.
instruct: Neutral, even narration with a slight contemplative tone.

speaker: SUBARU
text: Umm, Frederica, you’ve been working in the mansion for a while?
instruct: Casual, hesitant tone with a questioning inflection.

speaker: FREDERICA
text: Oh, are you interested? Emilia-sama, the girl in your arms… and Beatrice-sama…you seem to have a lot of interests.
instruct: Sarcastic, teasing delivery with a hint of amusement.

speaker: SUBARU
text: Stop mixing Beako in so smoothly, I’m not interested in young kids. You can see that both my hands are filled with Emilia-tan and Rem, right? Frederica is… Honestly, it’s only been a short time, but you’re not my type.
instruct: Defiant, dismissive tone with a touch of sarcasm.

speaker: FREDERICA
text: Oh, I’m hated.
instruct: Sarcastic, dry delivery with a hint of self-deprecation.

speaker: SUBARU
text: It’s no good, you trying to yank my chain feels just like what one of Roswaal’s maids would do. Oh, and it’s only an issue of personal preference, I don’t hate you or anything.
instruct: Mocking, condescending tone with a teasing edge.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Frederica’s eyes danced, and she laughed at Subaru’s comeback, while covering her mouth with its cruel-looking fangs.
instruct: Neutral, even narration with a subtle description of Frederica’s expression.

speaker: FREDERICA
text: I’m not much concerned. You, also seem to be a worrywart.
instruct: Cold, dismissive tone with a hint of superiority.

speaker: SUBARU
text: It’s because I hurt you when we first met. You laughed it off, but it still hurt a bit, didn’t it?
instruct: Guilt-ridden, apologetic tone with a hint of sincerity.

speaker: NARRATOR
instruct: Neutral, even narration.

speaker: NARRATOR
text:
At Subaru’s words, Frederica’s eyes flickered with an expression of surprise this time. The smile wiped from her face, she stared at him. The gold in her eyes sparkling, she slid her gaze to meet his, and Subaru was met with the sensation that she was trying to look through him.

Slowly letting out a small sigh, Frederica said,
instruct: Neutral, even narration with a dramatic, suspenseful build.

speaker: FREDERICA
text: It is not very often that someone sees into my heart. I would appreciate it, if you refrained from doing so.
instruct: Cold, formal tone with a hint of emotional distance.

speaker: SUBARU
text: I just tried to put back together what I’d trampled over. Besides, I’m one to talk, what with my eyes being just as fierce looking… Well, for me it’s the whole family though.
instruct: Self-deprecating, humorous tone with a touch of sincerity.

speaker: NARRATOR
text:
Since both his parents had naturally fierce expressions, their son had it too.

During dinner, they all wore the same expressions as they squirted out mayonnaise from their own personal tubes, and it probably looked as though they were performing some black magic ritual around the dining table. Frowning as he saw his own memories objectively, Frederica deepened her sigh even further.
instruct: Neutral, even narration with a slightly humorous and observational tone.

speaker: FREDERICA
text: You are not a discomforting guy, just really strange. I think I understand why Emilia-sama behaves the way she does.
instruct: Sarcastic, teasing tone with a hint of amusement.

speaker: SUBARU
text: Emilia-tan, what?
instruct: Confused, hesitant tone with a questioning inflection.

speaker: FREDERICA
text: It is nothing. This time, Emilia-sama would truly be upset with me. What will you do once you know how long I have worked here?
instruct: Neutral, even narration with a slightly ominous undertone.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Shaking her head, Frederica shifted the topic back. Even though he couldn’t make sense of those words, Subaru too returned to the original topic.
instruct: Casual, conversational tone with a hint of curiosity.

speaker: SUBARU
text: So the thing is, I wanted to talk about Beako… Beatrice. If you worked here as a maid for a long time, then I wanted to ask how long she’s been living in the Mansion.
instruct: Neutral, even narration with a slightly analytical tone.

speaker: NARRATOR
text:
He hadn’t voiced it as a question or anything, but from Subaru’s estimation, Frederica was several years older, around twenty-two or twenty-three. Even if she was a veteran maid of ten years, and since Beatrice was around twelve now by all accounts, all he had to do was count back and he could come up with an estimate.

But, at Subaru’s question, Frederica shook her head.
instruct: Cold, formal tone with a hint of emotional distance.

speaker: FREDERICA
text: I am sorry, but I do not know. Beatrice-sama has shut herself up in the Library a long time, since before I started working in this Mansion.
instruct: Casual, apologetic tone with a hint of resignation.

speaker: SUBARU
text: Ah, well I guess it can’t be helped. Your background as a maid doesn’t necessarily mean it directly correlates with how long you’ve worked in Ros-chi’s Mansion. So you came to the mansion as an expert maid then…
instruct: Casual, conversational tone with a hint of curiosity.

speaker: FREDERICA
text: No, that is not the case, Subaru-sama.
instruct: Cold, formal tone with a hint of superiority.

speaker: NARRATOR
text:
Frederica interrupted Subaru, who felt his conclusion had been denied by a rather plausible reason.

As Subaru furrowed his brows, she straightened her back, and complemented by her vicious countenance and a noticeable concern, she said,
instruct: Neutral, even narration with a dramatic, suspenseful build.

speaker: FREDERICA
text: The only place I have worked at as a maid, is here at the Master’s mansion. And when I was first taken in as a servant, I was twelve years old. That was over ten years ago.
instruct: Cold, formal tone with a hint of emotional distance.

speaker: SUBARU
text: …Wait, isn’t that weird? Because, calculating back since then, that would mean Beako has been shut-up in that moldy room from when she was a toddler.
instruct: Subaru speaks with confusion and a hint of disbelief, voice slightly strained.

speaker: FREDERICA
text: Don’t you, already know?
instruct: Frederica's tone is sharp and dismissive, with a subtle edge of impatience.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: As though criticizing Subaru’s stubbornness, Frederica shook her head. With her attitude confirming a doubt he had held within his heart, Subaru understood what he had tried to avoid thinking about too deeply. In other words, the girl in the library―.
instruct: Narrator delivers the line with a calm, observational tone, describing actions and emotions objectively.

speaker: SUBARU
text: Her appearance hasn’t changed… I guess she really isn’t human then.
instruct: Subaru's voice is tinged with shock and a slow realization, speaking with a mix of awe and unease.

speaker: FREDERICA
text: Since the beginning of the Mathers Family, the librarian who took an Oath to continue watching over the Forbidden Library ―― that is who she is, the Great Spirit²⁰ Beatrice-sama.
instruct: Frederica speaks with a formal, authoritative tone, emphasizing the importance of the title and her role.

speaker: NARRATOR
text:
Unable to detect a lie in her words, Subaru was left with no choice but to accept them.

The true identity of the girl he had interacted with until now, was an existence that belonged to a completely different dimension.
instruct: Narrator delivers the line with a reflective, slightly somber tone, highlighting the weight of the revelation.

speaker: SUBARU
text: Great Spirit… That title is the same as Puck’s, but she looks really different and all.
instruct: Subaru's voice is curious and slightly confused, noting the contrast between titles and appearances.

speaker: FREDERICA
text: It relates to the absence of a contract and the Oath… no, this is more than I should say. Please forget it.
instruct: Frederica's tone is hesitant and apologetic, with a hint of reluctance to share more.

speaker: SUBARU
text: Impossible, totally impossible.
instruct: Subaru's voice is frustrated and exasperated, expressing disbelief and irritation.

speaker: NARRATOR
text:
How many times had Subaru’s ignorance caused him to be dragged around by what other people knew but wouldn’t share?

Frederica did not care about Subaru’s scornful glare and tightened her lips, it seems she had no intention of touching the subject again. At her attitude and behavior, Subaru sighed, recognizing that he would be unable to pursue talking about Beatrice.

Remembering their talk had continued on while their legs had ceased moving,
instruct: Narrator delivers the line with a reflective, slightly melancholic tone, emphasizing Subaru's emotional state.

speaker: SUBARU
text: Frederica…
instruct: Subaru's voice is hesitant and uncertain, with a soft, almost questioning tone.

speaker: FREDERICA
text: Forgive me, Subaru-sama. My tongue was a little too loose. I was just glad someone appeared that cares about Beatrice-sama. Please, forgive me.
instruct: Frederica speaks with sincerity and a slight tremor in her voice, showing genuine remorse.

speaker: SUBARU
text: It’s okay, but my arms are at their limit.
instruct: Subaru's voice is strained and weary, showing physical and emotional exhaustion.

speaker: NARRATOR
text:
His upper arms shaking, Subaru looked up at Frederica with a stiff expression on his face.

He was acting strong because
instruct: Narrator delivers the line with a calm, almost conversational tone, setting up the next line.

text: it’s a light light body
speaker: FREDERICA
instruct: Frederica's tone is cheerful and light, almost playful in delivery.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: and
instruct: Narrator delivers the line with a neutral, almost poetic tone, continuing the previous line.

text: anything’s possible with love
speaker: FREDERICA
instruct: Frederica's tone is warm and sincere, emphasizing the emotional weight of her words.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: , but things like his arm strength, muscle stamina, and so on, ignored those lines, attacking him in force.
instruct: Narrator delivers the line with a slightly dramatic tone, highlighting the contrast between words and reality.

speaker: FREDERICA
text: Oh, oh.
instruct: Frederica's voice is soft and apologetic, with a hint of nervousness.

speaker: SUBARU
text: So, step away, please!
instruct: Subaru's voice is firm and exasperated, showing a clear desire to end the conversation.

speaker: NARRATOR
text:
Subaru swore to himself he would never do something as foolish as setting Rem down on the floor, or handing her to Frederica then brushed past her and her offer to switch, heading to the guest room with hurried steps.

The sounds of soft footfalls running echoed from behind, it seemed Frederica was following behind him. Reflecting on the horrible way he had ended their talk, he arrived in front of Rem’s room.
instruct: Narrator delivers the line with a calm, observational tone, describing actions and emotions objectively.

speaker: EMILIA
text: ―You really, took your time.
instruct: Emilia's tone is dry and slightly sarcastic, showing her impatience.

speaker: NARRATOR
text:

Of course, in reality, such a thing could not possibly happen. Even the largest human could not hope to disturb the foundations of the world with a simple stamp of the foot, and the sheer weight of the earth would not budge so easily. So, the tilting of the world can only be Subaru’s illusion.

How much time had passed, it was impossible to tell in the darkness. Even his thoughts became vague, and his throat, which had already given up on calling out, froze. Walking on like this, exhaustion did not come to him, but because of this, the sensation of his limbs began to blur as well.

His most abhorrent and bitter memory was the time the gigantic Puck killed him as he mocked him. That time, in Petelgeuse and Puck’s conversation, her name had appeared. On the verge of death, Subaru’s consciousness had not understood what it meant, and he had not remembered it again until now.

Hearing Subaru’s mutters as he found this memory, Echidna lifted up her face.
instruct: Narrator delivers the scene with a somber, reflective tone, emphasizing the weight of Subaru's memories.

speaker: ECHIDNA
text: Puck…? You don’t mean, the cat Spirit…?
instruct: Echidna's voice is sharp and questioning, her tone revealing a sudden interest and curiosity.

speaker: SUBARU
text: ――!? Yeah, that’s right. The cat Spirit. Do you know Puck?
instruct: Subaru's voice is surprised and emphatic, his tone showing a mix of confusion and urgency.

speaker: ECHIDNA
text: It’s not whether I know him… Did he come here? If that’s case, just how much does he remember?
instruct: Echidna's voice is tense and guarded, her tone revealing a hidden concern and hesitation.

speaker: NARRATOR
text:
Echidna seemed shocked to hear this unexpected name, and Subaru was just as shocked to see this reaction from her. Echidna, who had been talking nonstop up to now, suddenly fell silent.

Seeing her ominous attitude, Subaru couldn’t say a thing. And Echidna, as if sinking into thought again, shut her eyes in deep contemplation. Wondering how to continue this conversation, Subaru turned up his gaze,
instruct: Narrator delivers the scene with a calm, observational tone, highlighting the growing tension between characters.

speaker: SUBARU
text: ――Gaah!?
instruct: Subaru's voice is strained and pained, his tone showing sudden physical distress and shock.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: All of sudden, in the bottom of his stomach, a searing heat asserting its own existence drew the entirety of his consciousness.
instruct: Narrator delivers the scene with a slow, ominous tone, emphasizing the intensity of Subaru's suffering.

speaker: SUBARU
text: …Uh, ah?
instruct: Subaru's voice is weak and trembling, his tone showing physical weakness and confusion.

speaker: NARRATOR
text:
The tremendous heat felt as if it would burn through his entrails. Groaning, Subaru held his stomach, his legs trembling feebly.

The abrupt, surging pain was beyond anything ordinary. A stomachache would be nothing compared to this mysterious anguish that made him foam at the mouth. Unable to stand, he fell to his knees, and, in the next moment, dropped to the side. Seeing Subaru like this,
instruct: Narrator delivers the scene with a detached, clinical tone, describing Subaru's condition without emotion.

speaker: ECHIDNA
text: Ah, it’s finally taken effect.
instruct: Echidna's voice is calm and mocking, her tone showing a cold, calculated satisfaction.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: And, admiring the sight with her cold, unfeeling eyes, Echidna gazed down at him. Slowly, she approached the writhing Subaru, bent down her knees to get closer to his face, and brushed aside the hair over Subaru’s forehead,
instruct: Narrator delivers the scene with a slow, deliberate tone, emphasizing Echidna's actions and Subaru's vulnerability.

speaker: ECHIDNA
text: When you’re invited to a Witch’s tea party, you shouldn’t be putting everything you’ve been given into your mouth so carelessly―― You’ve learned a lesson now, haven’t you?
instruct: Echidna's voice is cold and mocking, her tone showing a mix of superiority and amusement.

speaker: SUBARU
text: You, di… you poison me…?
instruct: Subaru's voice is weak and accusatory, his tone showing confusion and pain.

speaker: ECHIDNA
text: Out of the question. I told you, didn’t I? What you drank were my body fluids. A part of a fundamentally different existence, a part of a Witch. That, is what you consumed.
instruct: Echidna's voice is calm and defensive, her tone showing a mix of justification and cold logic.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Body fluids. Subaru realized he had overlooked the significance of that term in all the conversation that came afterwards. And the consequence, was this state of his current agony. Opening his eyes, he glared at Echidna. All the friendly attitude of before had long evaporated. Just what did she want to achieve by doing such a thing――.
instruct: Narrator delivers the scene with a tense, observational tone, highlighting Subaru's shift in attitude.

speaker: ECHIDNA
text: I don’t want you to misunderstand, I didn’t do this out of malice or any ill-will towards you. In fact, I regard your existence quite positively. Letting you drink a part of me is proof of that.
instruct: Echidna's voice is measured and composed, her tone showing a mix of sincerity and cold logic.

speaker: SUBARU
text: Sp… eak so I can… under…stand…
instruct: Subaru's voice is strained and desperate, his tone showing a struggle to understand and endure.

speaker: ECHIDNA
text: To put it simply, I lent you a hand so the dormant Witch Factor³¹ inside you could settle down more easily… or something along those lines.
instruct: Echidna's voice is calm and matter-of-fact, her tone revealing a mix of confidence and detachment.

speaker: SUBARU
text: Witch, Factor…?
instruct: Subaru speaks with confusion and hesitation, as if trying to grasp a complex concept.

speaker: NARRATOR
text:
The incessant heat growing in intensity, Subaru used every last ounce of his strength to repeat that word.

――Witch Factor.

That word too, he had heard several times before. There was Petelgeuse. And then there was Beatrice.
instruct: Narrator delivers a calm, descriptive account of Subaru's physical and mental state.

speaker: ECHIDNA
text: You killed an agent of the Witch of Envy, didn’t you? With that agent’s death, the Witch Factor implanted itself inside you… However, there seems to be something else inside you as well.
instruct: Echidna speaks with a calm, analytical tone, explaining complex concepts with ease.

speaker: SUBARU
text: That thing, when it familiarizes… What’ll happen?
instruct: Subaru asks with urgency, showing concern about the implications of the Witch Factor.

speaker: ECHIDNA
text: Indeed, whatever would happen? Honestly, I am not sure myself. But, compared to carrying around a bomb that blows up who knows when, it’s better to detonate it before it causes anything worse, I think. If we can settle this inside a dream, perhaps it’ll make the undetonated part easier to deal with once you’re outside.
instruct: Echidna speaks with a casual, almost dismissive tone, comparing the situation to a bomb.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Listening to that indifferent tone, Subaru felt like his consciousness was about to fade, as light and dark flashed before his eyes in sync with the surging of his pain. But even in this state, Subaru slightly raised his arm, and pointed toward Echidna,
instruct: Narrator describes Subaru's physical suffering and determination with a somber, intense tone.

speaker: SUBARU
text: Just now, I thought of something…
instruct: Subaru speaks with a weak, strained voice, showing signs of exhaustion and pain.

speaker: ECHIDNA
text: Hm?
instruct: Echidna responds with a short, curious tone, showing mild surprise.

speaker: SUBARU
text: You… The way you talk… is, just like Puck. That cat spirit too, doesn’t care about the mood at all, just goes around with that careless air, goes on like there’s nothing…
instruct: Subaru speaks with a mix of frustration and realization, pointing out Echidna's similarities to Puck.

speaker: NARRATOR
text:
Listening to Subaru’s wrenched out words, for an instant, Echidna blinked in surprise.

Then, with an exaggerated expression, as though she had just heard the funniest joke, Echidna held her stomach as she burst out laughing.
instruct: Narrator describes Echidna's reaction with a dramatic, exaggerated tone.

speaker: ECHIDNA
text: Haha! Hahaha! Aaah, that is quite, a good one! You are fascinating. I really think so. Mmm, mha, aaahahahaha! Is that so, me and Puck? Mmmm, you’re quite right. That would be only natural, of course. I’m probably the only one who he’d take as something like a role model³².
instruct: Echidna laughs with exaggerated enthusiasm, showing amusement at Subaru's comment.

speaker: SUBARU
text: What, are y――
instruct: Subaru speaks with a weak, broken voice, struggling to continue his sentence.

speaker: NARRATOR
text:
.

Though he wanted to continue his sentence, it was no longer something he could do.

The pain had set his entire body ablaze, yet it would not deprive him of his consciousness. It had felt as though it would continue forever, and there would be no respite from this anguish, but… the end was already nearing. Though, it was not by overcoming the pain, but rather,
instruct: Narrator describes Subaru's physical state with a somber, slow-paced tone.

speaker: ECHIDNA
text: The time for our tryst is almost up, it seems.
instruct: Echidna speaks with a calm, almost mocking tone, indicating the end of their conversation.

speaker: NARRATOR
text:
Little by little, in Subaru’s eyes, the outlines of the world began to blur.

The blue sky, and the little hill in the green grass-covered fields. The two of them, and the chairs surrounding a white table. All these images blended into one, and together, began to fade.
instruct: Narrator describes Subaru's fading vision with a slow, fading tone.

speaker: SUBARU
text: I thought you said it’ll only end when you want it to end…
instruct: Subaru speaks with confusion and disbelief, questioning Echidna's earlier statement.

speaker: ECHIDNA
text: We have reached the time limit relative to the real world. The Trial you mentioned, it seems it will begin soon. When it does begin, all the functions of this Tomb will be directed towards it. And it won’t be caring about the lonely ghost anymore.
instruct: Echidna speaks with a calm, matter-of-fact tone, explaining the situation with ease.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Saying this in a lighthearted voice, Echidna caressed Subaru’s forehead as he lay on the ground. Watching him unable to resist, or even to react, she laughed.
instruct: Narrator describes Echidna's actions with a soft, almost affectionate tone.

speaker: ECHIDNA
text: Now, to return from a Witch’s tea party. What toll would you like to pay?
instruct: Echidna speaks with a playful, teasing tone, setting up the toll.

speaker: SUBARU
text: …Just so you know, I’m broke as hell right now.
instruct: Subaru speaks with a weak, apologetic tone, explaining his current situation.

speaker: ECHIDNA
text: Not money. The price is… Ah, yes. You are forbidden to speak of this space to anyone else, how about that? You seem to already have another contract just like it too… It is a small price to pay, is it not?
instruct: Echidna speaks with a calm, authoritative tone, explaining the terms of the contract.

speaker: NARRATOR
text:
What is that supposed to mean, there was no time to even ask that question.

Pressing her finger against Subaru’s forehead, she whispered something quietly. Then, sensing a heat coming from the finger that was touching him, in an instant, it spread throughout his entire body. And, incredibly, Subaru was granted an understanding. Of the terms of the contract, and what must not be infringed upon ― Thus, this one-sided agreement was sealed.
instruct: Narrator describes the sealing of the contract with a dramatic, intense tone.

speaker: SUBARU
text: Doing this, without even asking first…!
instruct: Subaru speaks with indignation and frustration, showing his anger at Echidna's actions.

speaker: ECHIDNA
text: Our conversation and consolidating the Witch Factor. Compared to that, I think this is a very small price to pay. Also, might as well while we’re at it, I will grant you a gift.
instruct: Echidna speaks with a calm, almost amused tone, offering a gift.

speaker: NARRATOR
text:
Smiling at the indignant Subaru, another wave of heat passed from her finger to his forehead.

And, the result of this heat was――.
instruct: Narrator describes the final act with a dramatic, suspenseful tone.

speaker: ECHIDNA
text: I hereby grant you the Qualification to participate in the Trial of this Tomb.
instruct: Deliver with a commanding, regal tone, emphasizing the gravity of the Qualification.

speaker: NARRATOR
instruct: Neutral, even narration.

speaker: ECHIDNA
text: With this, you will be able to take this Tomb’s Trial tonight. Whether you wish to take part is up to you. It is fine if you choose not to. But, if you want to, you could choose to take the Trial in place of the girl who is so very important to you―― What you do with it, you may decide as you like.
instruct: Speak with a mix of persuasion and menace, hinting at the weight of the choice offered.

speaker: NARRATOR
text:
The collapse of the world had begun. And little by little, what lay beneath his feet dissolved into darkness. This time, the true end of the world was drawing near.

Then, in the world that was coming to an end, Subaru, still lying on the ground, looked up at Echidna.

Sealing a contract he did not wish to sign, extorting from him a price he did not wish to pay, the girl who was smiling at him without a care in the world ― Ah, without a doubt,
instruct: Narrate with a slow, ominous cadence, building tension as the world collapses.

speaker: SUBARU
text: ――You are, truly, a Witch.
instruct: Utter with a mix of disbelief and realization, voice tinged with accusation.

speaker: ECHIDNA
text: ――Oh, but of course. I’m one wicked sorceress, isn’t that right?
instruct: Respond with a mocking, self-satisfied tone, reveling in the title of Witch.

speaker: NARRATOR
text:
With that final farewell, Subaru’s consciousness sprang from the dream.

Falling, and falling. Fading, and fading.

Breaking out of the dream, floating upwards,

At last, Subaru’s consciousness ― was released from the Witch’s dreams.

When Subaru was little, his athletics and learning were all ahead of other children his age. He could run faster than those around him, he was smarter than those the same age as him, and as if it were only natural, he was at the center of everything――.
instruct: Narrate with a dismissive, almost mocking tone, reflecting on Subaru's reputation.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: He’s that guy’s child, after all.
